en_def: a weakness in a system that an attacker can use to cause harm
hi_def: किसी सिस्टम की कमज़ोरी जिसका फ़ायदा हमलावर उठा सकता है
hi_nuance: Indian reports often write 'vulnerabilities' as 'vulnerabilties' (spelling) or overuse 'loophole'. In formal reports prefer 'vulnerability' or 'flaw', not 'bug' for security issues.

examples.en: I found a critical vulnerability in the login endpoint.
examples.hi: मुझे login endpoint में एक critical vulnerability मिली।

examples.en: This vulnerability allows an attacker to read other users' data.
examples.hi: यह vulnerability हमलावर को दूसरे users का data पढ़ने देती है।

examples.en: We reported the vulnerability through the responsible disclosure program.
examples.hi: हमने यह vulnerability responsible disclosure program के ज़रिये report की।

examples.en: The vulnerability was patched in version 2.3.
examples.hi: यह vulnerability version 2.3 में ठीक कर दी गई।

examples.en: Chaining two low-severity vulnerabilities led to full account takeover.
examples.hi: दो low-severity vulnerabilities को chain करने से पूरा account takeover हो गया।

common_mistake.wrong: There is a vulnerability issue in the system.
common_mistake.right: There is a vulnerability in the system.
common_mistake.why: 'vulnerability' already means a security issue; adding 'issue' is redundant.

cloze.sentence: An attacker can exploit this ____ to bypass authentication.

en_def: the act of fixing a security problem
hi_def: किसी सुरक्षा समस्या को ठीक करने की क्रिया
hi_nuance: Often confused with 'mitigation'. Remediation removes the root cause; mitigation only reduces the risk. Use the right one in reports.

examples.en: The remediation steps are listed at the end of the report.
examples.hi: Remediation के steps report के अंत में दिए गए हैं।

examples.en: Remediation requires input validation on the server side.
examples.hi: Remediation के लिए server side पर input validation ज़रूरी है।

examples.en: We agreed on a 30-day remediation timeline.
examples.hi: हमने 30-दिन की remediation timeline पर सहमति बनाई।

examples.en: Full remediation was verified in the retest.
examples.hi: पूरी remediation retest में verify की गई।

examples.en: Until remediation is complete, we suggest a temporary workaround.
examples.hi: जब तक remediation पूरी नहीं होती, हम एक अस्थायी workaround सुझाते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: Please do the remediation of this issue.
common_mistake.right: Please remediate this issue.
common_mistake.why: The verb 'remediate' is more concise than 'do the remediation of'.

cloze.sentence: The report includes clear ____ steps for the development team.

en_def: to make a problem or risk less serious, without fully removing it
hi_def: किसी समस्या या ख़तरे को कम करना, पूरी तरह हटाए बिना
hi_nuance: Indian speakers sometimes write 'mitigate the risk down' — 'down' is unnecessary. Also do not confuse with 'militate'.

examples.en: A web application firewall can mitigate this attack.
examples.hi: एक web application firewall इस हमले को mitigate कर सकता है।

examples.en: Rate limiting mitigates brute-force attempts.
examples.hi: Rate limiting brute-force कोशिशों को mitigate करता है।

examples.en: This control mitigates the risk but does not eliminate it.
examples.hi: यह control जोखिम को mitigate करता है पर पूरी तरह ख़त्म नहीं करता।

examples.en: We mitigated the exposure by rotating the leaked keys.
examples.hi: हमने leaked keys बदलकर exposure को mitigate किया।

examples.en: To mitigate the impact, restrict the endpoint to admins.
examples.hi: Impact mitigate करने के लिए endpoint को सिर्फ़ admins तक सीमित करें।

common_mistake.wrong: This will mitigate the risk down completely.
common_mistake.right: This will mitigate the risk.
common_mistake.why: 'mitigate' means reduce, so 'down completely' contradicts and is redundant.

cloze.sentence: Input validation helps ____ injection attacks.

en_def: to raise something to a higher level, such as privileges or an issue to senior staff
hi_def: किसी चीज़ को ऊँचे स्तर पर ले जाना, जैसे privileges या किसी मुद्दे को वरिष्ठ लोगों तक
hi_nuance: Two senses: (1) privilege escalation in hacking, (2) escalating an issue to a manager. Keep them clear in reports.

examples.en: I could escalate from a normal user to an administrator.
examples.hi: मैं एक normal user से administrator तक escalate कर सका।

examples.en: Please escalate this ticket to the security team.
examples.hi: कृपया इस ticket को security team तक escalate करें।

examples.en: The bug lets a low-privileged account escalate its rights.
examples.hi: यह bug कम-privilege वाले account को अपने rights escalate करने देता है।

examples.en: If there is no reply in 48 hours, I will escalate.
examples.hi: अगर 48 घंटे में जवाब नहीं आया, तो मैं escalate करूँगा।

examples.en: The attacker escalated privileges by abusing a setuid binary.
examples.hi: हमलावर ने एक setuid binary का दुरुपयोग करके privileges escalate किए।

common_mistake.wrong: I want to escalate this issue to upper.
common_mistake.right: I want to escalate this issue to management.
common_mistake.why: 'upper' is not a noun here; name the audience, e.g. 'management' or 'the security team'.

cloze.sentence: This flaw lets a guest account ____ to full admin rights.

en_def: to make information known, especially details of a security flaw
hi_def: जानकारी सार्वजनिक करना, ख़ासकर किसी सुरक्षा कमज़ोरी की
hi_nuance: In security, 'disclose responsibly' is a fixed phrase. Do not write 'disclose about' — 'disclose' takes a direct object.

examples.en: We will not disclose the details until a patch is released.
examples.hi: जब तक patch release नहीं होता, हम details disclose नहीं करेंगे।

examples.en: The researcher disclosed the bug to the vendor first.
examples.hi: Researcher ने bug पहले vendor को disclose किया।

examples.en: Please do not disclose this vulnerability publicly.
examples.hi: कृपया इस vulnerability को सार्वजनिक रूप से disclose न करें।

examples.en: The endpoint discloses internal IP addresses.
examples.hi: यह endpoint internal IP addresses को disclose करता है।

examples.en: Full disclosure happened after the 90-day window.
examples.hi: पूरा disclosure 90-दिन की अवधि के बाद हुआ।

common_mistake.wrong: I want to disclose about this bug to the vendor.
common_mistake.right: I want to disclose this bug to the vendor.
common_mistake.why: 'disclose' is transitive; drop 'about'.

cloze.sentence: The application accidentally ____ the database password in an error message.

en_def: to make a problem happen again by following the same steps
hi_def: समान steps अपनाकर किसी समस्या को दोबारा घटित करना
hi_nuance: 'Steps to reproduce' is a fixed report heading. Avoid 'regenerate the bug'; the standard verb is 'reproduce'.

examples.en: I was able to reproduce the issue on the latest build.
examples.hi: मैं latest build पर इस issue को reproduce कर सका।

examples.en: The following steps reproduce the vulnerability.
examples.hi: नीचे दिए steps इस vulnerability को reproduce करते हैं।

examples.en: The team could not reproduce the crash.
examples.hi: Team crash को reproduce नहीं कर सकी।

examples.en: Please share the exact request so I can reproduce it.
examples.hi: कृपया exact request भेजें ताकि मैं इसे reproduce कर सकूँ।

examples.en: The bug is intermittent and hard to reproduce.
examples.hi: यह bug रुक-रुक कर आता है और reproduce करना कठिन है।

common_mistake.wrong: Kindly regenerate the same bug at your end.
common_mistake.right: Please reproduce the bug on your side.
common_mistake.why: Standard term is 'reproduce'; 'at your end' is an Indianism for 'on your side'.

cloze.sentence: I have attached a video showing how to ____ the flaw.

en_def: the set of systems or targets that are allowed to be tested
hi_def: उन systems या targets का समूह जिन्हें test करने की अनुमति है
hi_nuance: 'In scope' and 'out of scope' are fixed phrases. Do not write 'in the scope' in bug bounty context.

examples.en: The API subdomain is in scope for this test.
examples.hi: यह API subdomain इस test के लिए in scope है।

examples.en: Testing the payment gateway is out of scope.
examples.hi: Payment gateway को test करना out of scope है।

examples.en: Please confirm the scope before I start.
examples.hi: शुरू करने से पहले कृपया scope confirm करें।

examples.en: The finding falls within the agreed scope.
examples.hi: यह finding तय की गई scope के अंदर आती है।

examples.en: Scope creep made the engagement run late.
examples.hi: Scope creep की वजह से engagement देर से पूरा हुआ।

common_mistake.wrong: This target is in the scope, right?
common_mistake.right: This target is in scope, right?
common_mistake.why: In bug bounty English, the fixed phrase is 'in scope' without 'the'.

cloze.sentence: Before reporting, check that the domain is ____ scope.

en_def: the process of sorting reported issues by priority and validity
hi_def: report की गई समस्याओं को प्राथमिकता और सच्चाई के आधार पर छाँटने की प्रक्रिया
hi_nuance: Also used as a verb: 'to triage a report'. Pronounced 'TREE-ahzh', not 'try-age'.

examples.en: The report is still waiting for triage.
examples.hi: यह report अभी triage का इंतज़ार कर रही है।

examples.en: Their triage team responded within a day.
examples.hi: उनकी triage team ने एक दिन में जवाब दिया।

examples.en: During triage, the analyst confirmed the severity.
examples.hi: Triage के दौरान analyst ने severity confirm की।

examples.en: Please triage this ticket as high priority.
examples.hi: कृपया इस ticket को high priority के रूप में triage करें।

examples.en: Fast triage keeps researchers engaged.
examples.hi: तेज़ triage researchers को जोड़े रखता है।

common_mistake.wrong: The report is in triaging since one week.
common_mistake.right: The report has been in triage for one week.
common_mistake.why: Use present perfect with 'for a period'; 'since' needs a start point.

cloze.sentence: After ____, the team marked the bug as a valid high-severity issue.

en_def: how serious or damaging a security issue is
hi_def: कोई सुरक्षा समस्या कितनी गंभीर या नुक़सानदेह है
hi_nuance: Severity (technical seriousness) differs from priority (order of fixing). Don't use them interchangeably in reports.

examples.en: I rated the severity as high based on the impact.
examples.hi: Impact के आधार पर मैंने severity को high रखा।

examples.en: The CVSS score reflects the severity.
examples.hi: CVSS score severity को दर्शाता है।

examples.en: Severity depends on both impact and likelihood.
examples.hi: Severity impact और likelihood दोनों पर निर्भर करती है।

examples.en: They downgraded the severity after review.
examples.hi: समीक्षा के बाद उन्होंने severity घटा दी।

examples.en: A low-severity bug can still be worth reporting.
examples.hi: एक low-severity bug भी report करने लायक हो सकता है।

common_mistake.wrong: The severity of this bug is very much high.
common_mistake.right: The severity of this bug is high.
common_mistake.why: 'very much high' is not standard; use 'high' or 'very high'.

cloze.sentence: Because it needs admin access, the ____ was lowered to medium.

en_def: a series of vulnerabilities combined to achieve a bigger attack
hi_def: कई vulnerabilities को जोड़कर बनाया गया एक बड़ा हमला
hi_nuance: Use when a single bug is low impact but combining several gives serious results. Also called a 'chain'.

examples.en: The exploit chain turned an open redirect into account takeover.
examples.hi: इस exploit chain ने एक open redirect को account takeover में बदल दिया।

examples.en: Each step of the exploit chain is documented below.
examples.hi: Exploit chain का हर step नीचे documented है।

examples.en: Alone, these bugs are minor; as an exploit chain they are critical.
examples.hi: अकेले ये bugs छोटे हैं; exploit chain के रूप में ये critical हैं।

examples.en: Breaking any link stops the exploit chain.
examples.hi: कोई भी link तोड़ने से exploit chain रुक जाती है।

examples.en: I demonstrated the full exploit chain in the video.
examples.hi: मैंने video में पूरी exploit chain demonstrate की।

common_mistake.wrong: By chaining, I make the exploit chain of three bugs.
common_mistake.right: By chaining three bugs, I built a full exploit chain.
common_mistake.why: Awkward phrasing; 'chain' the bugs to 'build' the exploit chain.

cloze.sentence: The researcher combined three flaws into a single ____.

en_def: seeming reasonable or believable
hi_def: जो उचित या विश्वसनीय लगे
hi_nuance: Use to argue that an attack scenario is realistic. Do not confuse with 'feasible' (technically possible).

examples.en: It is plausible that an insider could reach this endpoint.
examples.hi: यह plausible है कि कोई insider इस endpoint तक पहुँच सकता है।

examples.en: The attack is plausible given the weak password policy.
examples.hi: कमज़ोर password policy को देखते हुए यह हमला plausible है।

examples.en: I gave a plausible reason why the risk is real.
examples.hi: मैंने एक plausible कारण दिया कि जोखिम असली क्यों है।

examples.en: That excuse is not plausible.
examples.hi: वह बहाना plausible नहीं है।

examples.en: A plausible attacker would target the admin panel first.
examples.hi: एक plausible हमलावर पहले admin panel को target करेगा।

common_mistake.wrong: This attack scenario is very plausible-able.
common_mistake.right: This attack scenario is very plausible.
common_mistake.why: 'plausible' is already an adjective; there is no '-able' form to add.

cloze.sentence: The reviewer accepted the report because the scenario was ____.

en_def: possible to do in practice
hi_def: जो व्यवहार में करना संभव हो
hi_nuance: 'feasible' = technically possible; 'plausible' = believable. Reviewers ask whether an attack is feasible in the real world.

examples.en: The attack is feasible with a standard laptop.
examples.hi: यह हमला एक सामान्य laptop से feasible है।

examples.en: Brute-forcing the token is not feasible in a reasonable time.
examples.hi: Token को brute-force करना उचित समय में feasible नहीं है।

examples.en: Is it feasible to fix this before the release?
examples.hi: क्या इसे release से पहले ठीक करना feasible है?

examples.en: Exploitation is feasible only on outdated versions.
examples.hi: Exploitation सिर्फ़ पुराने versions पर feasible है।

examples.en: We chose the most feasible remediation.
examples.hi: हमने सबसे feasible remediation चुनी।

common_mistake.wrong: Is this fix feasible or not feasible, kindly confirm.
common_mistake.right: Could you confirm whether this fix is feasible?
common_mistake.why: Cleaner phrasing; 'kindly confirm' is an over-formal Indianism.

cloze.sentence: The reviewer asked whether the attack was ____ against a patched server.

en_def: the harm that results if a vulnerability is exploited
hi_def: अगर किसी vulnerability का फ़ायदा उठाया जाए तो होने वाला नुक़सान
hi_nuance: A report should always state the impact. 'Impact' as a verb ('this impacts users') is fine but 'affect' is often clearer.

examples.en: The impact is full read access to all user records.
examples.hi: इसका impact सभी user records तक पूरी read access है।

examples.en: Please describe the business impact clearly.
examples.hi: कृपया business impact साफ़-साफ़ बताइए।

examples.en: Low likelihood but high impact makes this medium severity.
examples.hi: कम likelihood पर ऊँचा impact इसे medium severity बनाता है।

examples.en: The impact is limited to a single tenant.
examples.hi: Impact सिर्फ़ एक tenant तक सीमित है।

examples.en: Without a real impact, the report may be marked informative.
examples.hi: बिना असली impact के, report informative मानी जा सकती है।

common_mistake.wrong: This bug is impacting to the users badly.
common_mistake.right: This bug seriously affects the users.
common_mistake.why: 'impacting to' is wrong; use 'affects' or 'has an impact on'.

cloze.sentence: State the ____ so the team understands why the fix matters.

en_def: the chance that an event, such as an attack, will happen
hi_def: किसी घटना, जैसे हमले, के होने की संभावना
hi_nuance: Risk = likelihood × impact. Indian reports sometimes say 'chances are there'; prefer 'the likelihood is high'.

examples.en: The likelihood of exploitation is low without credentials.
examples.hi: बिना credentials के exploitation की likelihood कम है।

examples.en: Public exploit code raises the likelihood of attack.
examples.hi: सार्वजनिक exploit code हमले की likelihood बढ़ाता है।

examples.en: We estimate the likelihood as medium.
examples.hi: हम likelihood को medium आँकते हैं।

examples.en: Both likelihood and impact feed into the risk score.
examples.hi: Likelihood और impact दोनों risk score में जुड़ते हैं।

examples.en: The likelihood increases on internet-facing servers.
examples.hi: Internet-facing servers पर likelihood बढ़ जाती है।

common_mistake.wrong: Chances are there that attacker will exploit this.
common_mistake.right: There is a real likelihood that an attacker will exploit this.
common_mistake.why: 'chances are there' is an Indianism; use 'there is a likelihood that'.

cloze.sentence: The risk rating combines impact with the ____ of a successful attack.

en_def: all the points where an attacker could try to enter a system
hi_def: वे सभी बिंदु जहाँ से हमलावर किसी सिस्टम में घुसने की कोशिश कर सकता है
hi_nuance: Uncountable in most uses: 'reduce the attack surface', not 'reduce the attack surfaces'.

examples.en: Disabling unused ports reduces the attack surface.
examples.hi: अनुपयोगी ports बंद करने से attack surface घटती है।

examples.en: Every new feature adds to the attack surface.
examples.hi: हर नया feature attack surface बढ़ाता है।

examples.en: We mapped the external attack surface first.
examples.hi: हमने पहले external attack surface map की।

examples.en: A large attack surface is harder to defend.
examples.hi: बड़ी attack surface की रक्षा करना कठिन है।

examples.en: The API expanded the attack surface significantly.
examples.hi: इस API ने attack surface काफ़ी बढ़ा दी।

common_mistake.wrong: We reduced many attack surfaces of the app.
common_mistake.right: We reduced the attack surface of the app.
common_mistake.why: 'attack surface' is normally uncountable; keep it singular.

cloze.sentence: Turning off the debug endpoint shrinks the ____.

en_def: the path or method an attacker uses to reach a target
hi_def: वह रास्ता या तरीक़ा जिससे हमलावर किसी target तक पहुँचता है
hi_nuance: 'attack vector' is the common collocation. Different from 'payload' (what is delivered) and 'surface' (all entry points).

examples.en: The main attack vector is the file upload form.
examples.hi: मुख्य attack vector file upload form है।

examples.en: Phishing is a common initial-access vector.
examples.hi: Phishing एक आम initial-access vector है।

examples.en: We closed the most likely vector first.
examples.hi: हमने सबसे संभावित vector पहले बंद किया।

examples.en: This vector requires the victim to click a link.
examples.hi: इस vector के लिए victim का link पर click करना ज़रूरी है।

examples.en: There are several vectors to reach the admin API.
examples.hi: Admin API तक पहुँचने के कई vectors हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: The attacker used this vector to injection the payload.
common_mistake.right: The attacker used this vector to inject the payload.
common_mistake.why: 'injection' is a noun; the verb is 'inject'.

cloze.sentence: The upload form is the primary attack ____ for this exploit.

en_def: the data or code delivered by an attack to do the actual harm
hi_def: हमले द्वारा भेजा गया वह data या code जो असल नुक़सान करता है
hi_nuance: Countable: 'a payload', 'several payloads'. Don't confuse with 'vector' (the delivery path).

examples.en: The XSS payload runs when the page loads.
examples.hi: XSS payload page load होते ही चलता है।

examples.en: I crafted a payload that reads the session cookie.
examples.hi: मैंने एक payload बनाया जो session cookie पढ़ता है।

examples.en: The filter blocked the first payload but not the second.
examples.hi: Filter ने पहला payload रोका पर दूसरा नहीं।

examples.en: A URL-encoded payload bypassed the check.
examples.hi: एक URL-encoded payload check को bypass कर गया।

examples.en: The payload is included in the reproduction steps.
examples.hi: यह payload reproduction steps में शामिल है।

common_mistake.wrong: I sent the payloads which is blocked by filter.
common_mistake.right: I sent the payloads, which were blocked by the filter.
common_mistake.why: Subject-verb agreement: 'payloads ... were'; add 'the' before 'filter'.

cloze.sentence: The following ____ triggers the alert box, proving script execution.

en_def: a right or permission to do something in a system
hi_def: किसी सिस्टम में कुछ करने का अधिकार या अनुमति
hi_nuance: Commonly misspelled 'priviledge'. 'least privilege' and 'privilege escalation' are fixed phrases.

examples.en: The account had more privileges than it needed.
examples.hi: इस account के पास ज़रूरत से ज़्यादा privileges थे।

examples.en: Follow the principle of least privilege.
examples.hi: least privilege के सिद्धांत का पालन करें।

examples.en: The bug grants admin privileges to any user.
examples.hi: यह bug किसी भी user को admin privileges देता है।

examples.en: Reducing privileges limits the blast radius.
examples.hi: Privileges घटाने से नुक़सान का दायरा सीमित होता है।

examples.en: Privilege escalation is the core of this finding.
examples.hi: Privilege escalation इस finding का मूल है।

common_mistake.wrong: The user is having admin priviledge.
common_mistake.right: The user has admin privileges.
common_mistake.why: Spelling ('privilege'), no continuous with 'have', and plural 'privileges' reads better.

cloze.sentence: Applying least ____ means each account gets only the access it needs.

en_def: to raise something to a higher level, especially access rights
hi_def: किसी चीज़ को ऊँचे स्तर पर ले जाना, ख़ासकर access rights
hi_nuance: 'elevate privileges' is near-synonymous with 'escalate privileges'. Both are correct.

examples.en: The exploit lets a user elevate to root.
examples.hi: यह exploit एक user को root तक elevate करने देता है।

examples.en: I elevated my access using a misconfigured service.
examples.hi: मैंने एक misconfigured service से अपनी access elevate की।

examples.en: Once elevated, the attacker can read any file.
examples.hi: एक बार elevate होने पर, हमलावर कोई भी file पढ़ सकता है।

examples.en: The token was elevated without re-authentication.
examples.hi: Token बिना re-authentication के elevate हो गया।

examples.en: Do not elevate privileges beyond what the test allows.
examples.hi: Test की अनुमति से ज़्यादा privileges elevate न करें।

common_mistake.wrong: I did the elevation of my privilege to admin.
common_mistake.right: I elevated my privileges to admin.
common_mistake.why: Prefer the verb 'elevated' over 'did the elevation of'.

cloze.sentence: A local user can ____ their rights to administrator through this flaw.

en_def: to get around a security control instead of going through it
hi_def: किसी सुरक्षा नियंत्रण से होकर जाने के बजाय उसे चकमा देना
hi_nuance: Both verb and noun ('an authentication bypass'). Do not add 'out': it is 'bypass the filter', not 'bypass out'.

examples.en: I could bypass the login page entirely.
examples.hi: मैं login page को पूरी तरह bypass कर सका।

examples.en: This payload bypasses the WAF.
examples.hi: यह payload WAF को bypass करता है।

examples.en: The finding is an authentication bypass.
examples.hi: यह finding एक authentication bypass है।

examples.en: They fixed one bypass, but another remained.
examples.hi: उन्होंने एक bypass ठीक किया, पर दूसरा बचा रहा।

examples.en: Changing the HTTP method bypassed the access check.
examples.hi: HTTP method बदलने से access check bypass हो गया।

common_mistake.wrong: Attacker can bypass out the OTP check.
common_mistake.right: An attacker can bypass the OTP check.
common_mistake.why: 'bypass' is transitive; do not add 'out', and use an article before 'attacker'.

cloze.sentence: By editing the cookie, I was able to ____ the paywall.

en_def: to clean input by removing or neutralising dangerous characters
hi_def: input को साफ़ करना, ख़तरनाक characters हटाकर या निष्क्रिय करके
hi_nuance: British spelling 'sanitise' is also fine; be consistent. Sanitising is not the same as validating.

examples.en: The app does not sanitize user input.
examples.hi: यह app user input को sanitize नहीं करता।

examples.en: Sanitize the filename before saving it.
examples.hi: Save करने से पहले filename को sanitize करें।

examples.en: Output should be sanitized to prevent XSS.
examples.hi: XSS रोकने के लिए output को sanitize करना चाहिए।

examples.en: Properly sanitized input closes this hole.
examples.hi: सही तरह sanitize किया गया input इस hole को बंद करता है।

examples.en: They sanitize on output but not on input.
examples.hi: वे output पर sanitize करते हैं पर input पर नहीं।

common_mistake.wrong: The input is not getting sanitized properly by the code.
common_mistake.right: The code does not sanitize the input properly.
common_mistake.why: Active voice is clearer; avoid the wordy 'is not getting ... by'.

cloze.sentence: Always ____ user-supplied data before using it in a query.

en_def: to check that input meets the expected rules before using it
hi_def: input को उपयोग करने से पहले जाँचना कि वह अपेक्षित नियमों को पूरा करता है
hi_nuance: Validation checks format/rules; sanitisation cleans content. Server-side validation is what matters for security.

examples.en: The server must validate the input, not just the browser.
examples.hi: सिर्फ़ browser नहीं, server को भी input validate करना चाहिए।

examples.en: Validate the email format before sending.
examples.hi: भेजने से पहले email format validate करें।

examples.en: Client-side validation alone can be bypassed.
examples.hi: अकेली client-side validation को bypass किया जा सकता है।

examples.en: The API failed to validate the object ID.
examples.hi: API object ID को validate करने में विफल रहा।

examples.en: We validate all uploaded file types.
examples.hi: हम सभी uploaded file types को validate करते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: The server is not validating properly the request.
common_mistake.right: The server does not validate the request properly.
common_mistake.why: Adverb placement: 'validate the request properly', and simple present reads better.

cloze.sentence: The endpoint does not ____ the user ID, allowing access to other accounts.

en_def: to convert data into a particular format, often to make it safe or transportable
hi_def: data को किसी ख़ास format में बदलना, अक्सर उसे सुरक्षित या भेजने योग्य बनाने के लिए
hi_nuance: Encoding is not encryption. 'Base64 encode' hides nothing; do not call it security in a report.

examples.en: URL-encode the payload to slip past the filter.
examples.hi: Filter से बचने के लिए payload को URL-encode करें।

examples.en: HTML-encode output to prevent script injection.
examples.hi: Script injection रोकने के लिए output को HTML-encode करें।

examples.en: The token is Base64-encoded, not encrypted.
examples.hi: Token Base64-encoded है, encrypted नहीं।

examples.en: They encode the value but never decode it safely.
examples.hi: वे value को encode करते हैं पर उसे कभी सुरक्षित रूप से decode नहीं करते।

examples.en: Double-encoding bypassed the naive filter.
examples.hi: Double-encoding ने साधारण filter को bypass कर दिया।

common_mistake.wrong: The password is encoded so it is fully secure.
common_mistake.right: The password is only encoded, not encrypted, so it is not secure.
common_mistake.why: Encoding is reversible and provides no confidentiality; don't equate it with security.

cloze.sentence: You should HTML-____ the comment before showing it on the page.

en_def: to change something in an unauthorised way, usually to cause harm
hi_def: किसी चीज़ को बिना अनुमति के बदलना, आमतौर पर नुक़सान पहुँचाने के लिए
hi_nuance: Always followed by 'with': 'tamper with the request'. 'tamper-proof' is a common adjective.

examples.en: An attacker can tamper with the price parameter.
examples.hi: एक हमलावर price parameter के साथ tamper कर सकता है।

examples.en: The client can tamper with the hidden field.
examples.hi: Client hidden field के साथ tamper कर सकता है।

examples.en: We detected request tampering in the logs.
examples.hi: हमने logs में request tampering का पता लगाया।

examples.en: Sign the token so it cannot be tampered with.
examples.hi: Token को sign करें ताकि उसके साथ tamper न किया जा सके।

examples.en: Tampering with the JWT changed the user role.
examples.hi: JWT के साथ tamper करने से user role बदल गया।

common_mistake.wrong: The attacker can tamper the request easily.
common_mistake.right: The attacker can tamper with the request easily.
common_mistake.why: 'tamper' needs the preposition 'with'.

cloze.sentence: Because the field is not signed, a user can ____ with it.

en_def: an unintended release of private information
hi_def: निजी जानकारी का अनजाने में बाहर निकल जाना
hi_nuance: Both noun and verb ('the API leaks the token'). For big incidents, 'breach' is stronger than 'leak'.

examples.en: The error page causes an information leak.
examples.hi: Error page एक information leak का कारण बनता है।

examples.en: The endpoint leaks the internal server version.
examples.hi: यह endpoint internal server version leak करता है।

examples.en: A memory leak is different from a data leak.
examples.hi: Memory leak, data leak से अलग है।

examples.en: The token leak let me impersonate other users.
examples.hi: Token leak ने मुझे दूसरे users का impersonate करने दिया।

examples.en: We closed the leak by removing the debug header.
examples.hi: हमने debug header हटाकर leak बंद किया।

common_mistake.wrong: The API is leaking the users data since long time.
common_mistake.right: The API has been leaking users' data for a long time.
common_mistake.why: Present perfect continuous with 'for'; add the possessive apostrophe.

cloze.sentence: A verbose stack trace can ____ sensitive file paths to the user.

en_def: the state of being unprotected and reachable by attackers
hi_def: असुरक्षित और हमलावरों की पहुँच में होने की स्थिति
hi_nuance: 'data exposure', 'sensitive data exposure' are common. Uncountable when general; countable for specific findings.

examples.en: The open S3 bucket caused sensitive data exposure.
examples.hi: खुली S3 bucket ने sensitive data exposure पैदा की।

examples.en: We reduced exposure by moving the service internal.
examples.hi: Service को internal करके हमने exposure घटाई।

examples.en: The exposure lasted for three days.
examples.hi: यह exposure तीन दिन तक रही।

examples.en: Public exposure of the admin panel is a serious risk.
examples.hi: Admin panel का public exposure एक गंभीर जोखिम है।

examples.en: Rotate the keys to limit the exposure.
examples.hi: Exposure सीमित करने के लिए keys rotate करें।

common_mistake.wrong: This causes exposure of the sensitive datas.
common_mistake.right: This causes exposure of sensitive data.
common_mistake.why: 'data' is uncountable; there is no 'datas'.

cloze.sentence: The misconfigured bucket led to sensitive data ____.

en_def: a setting that is wrong or insecure by mistake
hi_def: कोई setting जो ग़लती से ग़लत या असुरक्षित हो
hi_nuance: Very common finding type. Countable: 'a misconfiguration', 'several misconfigurations'.

examples.en: The finding is a CORS misconfiguration.
examples.hi: यह finding एक CORS misconfiguration है।

examples.en: A single misconfiguration exposed the database.
examples.hi: एक ही misconfiguration ने database को expose कर दिया।

examples.en: We found several misconfigurations in the cloud setup.
examples.hi: हमें cloud setup में कई misconfigurations मिलीं।

examples.en: This misconfiguration allows anonymous access.
examples.hi: यह misconfiguration anonymous access की अनुमति देती है।

examples.en: Fixing the misconfiguration takes only one line.
examples.hi: इस misconfiguration को ठीक करने में सिर्फ़ एक line लगती है।

common_mistake.wrong: There is a mis-configuration issue in the server.
common_mistake.right: There is a misconfiguration in the server.
common_mistake.why: One word, no hyphen; 'issue' is redundant.

cloze.sentence: The permissive header is a classic CORS ____.

en_def: the process of making a system more secure by reducing weaknesses
hi_def: कमज़ोरियाँ घटाकर किसी सिस्टम को अधिक सुरक्षित बनाने की प्रक्रिया
hi_nuance: Uncountable. 'server hardening', 'hardening guide'. The verb is 'harden'.

examples.en: We followed the CIS hardening guide.
examples.hi: हमने CIS hardening guide का पालन किया।

examples.en: Server hardening closed most default risks.
examples.hi: Server hardening ने अधिकतर default जोखिम बंद कर दिए।

examples.en: Hardening should happen before going live.
examples.hi: Live जाने से पहले hardening होनी चाहिए।

examples.en: Disable unused services as part of hardening.
examples.hi: Hardening के हिस्से के रूप में अनुपयोगी services बंद करें।

examples.en: The report recommends hardening the SSH config.
examples.hi: Report SSH config को harden करने की सलाह देती है।

common_mistake.wrong: Kindly do the hardening of the servers.
common_mistake.right: Please harden the servers.
common_mistake.why: Use the verb 'harden'; 'kindly do the ... of' is over-formal Indian English.

cloze.sentence: The team applied OS ____ to remove insecure defaults.

en_def: an update that fixes a bug or security flaw
hi_def: एक update जो किसी bug या सुरक्षा कमज़ोरी को ठीक करता है
hi_nuance: Both noun and verb ('patch the server'). 'patched version' is common. Do not say 'do the patching', prefer 'patch'.

examples.en: The vendor released a patch within a week.
examples.hi: Vendor ने एक हफ़्ते में patch release किया।

examples.en: Please patch the server before Monday.
examples.hi: कृपया Monday से पहले server को patch करें।

examples.en: The bug returned because the patch was incomplete.
examples.hi: Patch अधूरा होने से bug वापस आ गया।

examples.en: Apply the latest security patches.
examples.hi: नवीनतम security patches apply करें।

examples.en: I retested after the patch and the issue was gone.
examples.hi: Patch के बाद मैंने retest किया और issue ख़त्म था।

common_mistake.wrong: We will do the patching of this issue soon.
common_mistake.right: We will patch this issue soon.
common_mistake.why: Prefer the verb 'patch' over 'do the patching of'.

cloze.sentence: The vulnerability was fixed in the latest ____.

en_def: a return of a bug that a previous fix was supposed to remove
hi_def: किसी bug का वापस आ जाना जिसे पिछले fix से हटाया जाना था
hi_nuance: 'regression' here means a bug came back, not statistics. 'regression test' checks that fixes hold.

examples.en: A recent change caused a security regression.
examples.hi: हाल के एक change ने एक security regression पैदा की।

examples.en: Add a regression test so this bug never returns.
examples.hi: एक regression test जोड़ें ताकि यह bug कभी वापस न आए।

examples.en: The fix introduced a regression elsewhere.
examples.hi: इस fix ने कहीं और एक regression ला दी।

examples.en: We caught the regression during retesting.
examples.hi: हमने retesting के दौरान regression पकड़ी।

examples.en: This is a regression from version 3.1.
examples.hi: यह version 3.1 से एक regression है।

common_mistake.wrong: The bug is coming again, it is a regression only.
common_mistake.right: The bug has reappeared; this is a regression.
common_mistake.why: Avoid the filler 'only'; use present perfect for a change with present relevance.

cloze.sentence: The old flaw came back, so we filed it as a ____.

en_def: the underlying reason a problem happens, not just its symptoms
hi_def: किसी समस्या के होने का मूल कारण, सिर्फ़ उसके लक्षण नहीं
hi_nuance: 'root cause analysis' (RCA) is a fixed phrase. Fixing symptoms is not fixing the root cause.

examples.en: The root cause is missing server-side validation.
examples.hi: मूल कारण server-side validation का न होना है।

examples.en: We did a root cause analysis after the incident.
examples.hi: घटना के बाद हमने एक root cause analysis की।

examples.en: Patching the symptom leaves the root cause open.
examples.hi: लक्षण ठीक करने से root cause खुला रह जाता है।

examples.en: The root cause was a shared secret in the repo.
examples.hi: मूल कारण repo में एक shared secret था।

examples.en: Please address the root cause, not just this endpoint.
examples.hi: कृपया सिर्फ़ इस endpoint को नहीं, root cause को ठीक करें।

common_mistake.wrong: What is the main root reason of this bug?
common_mistake.right: What is the root cause of this bug?
common_mistake.why: The fixed phrase is 'root cause', not 'root reason'.

cloze.sentence: Fixing one page is not enough; we must fix the ____.

en_def: a demonstration that shows a vulnerability really works
hi_def: एक प्रदर्शन जो दिखाता है कि कोई vulnerability वाक़ई काम करती है
hi_nuance: Abbreviated PoC. Attach a PoC to strengthen a report. 'a proof of concept', countable.

examples.en: I have attached a proof of concept video.
examples.hi: मैंने एक proof of concept video attach की है।

examples.en: The proof of concept reads another user's email.
examples.hi: यह proof of concept दूसरे user का email पढ़ता है।

examples.en: Without a PoC, the report may be rejected.
examples.hi: बिना PoC के, report अस्वीकार हो सकती है।

examples.en: The PoC works on the production site.
examples.hi: यह PoC production site पर काम करता है।

examples.en: Keep the proof of concept minimal and safe.
examples.hi: Proof of concept को न्यूनतम और सुरक्षित रखें।

common_mistake.wrong: I am attaching the prove of concept.
common_mistake.right: I am attaching the proof of concept.
common_mistake.why: 'proof' is the noun; 'prove' is the verb.

cloze.sentence: The report includes a working ____ that leaks the admin token.

en_def: not included in what is allowed to be tested or reported
hi_def: जो test या report करने की अनुमति में शामिल नहीं है
hi_nuance: Fixed phrase; no article. Reports on out-of-scope assets are usually closed without reward.

examples.en: That subdomain is out of scope.
examples.hi: वह subdomain out of scope है।

examples.en: Denial-of-service testing is out of scope.
examples.hi: Denial-of-service testing out of scope है।

examples.en: I confirmed the target was not out of scope.
examples.hi: मैंने पुष्टि की कि target out of scope नहीं था।

examples.en: They closed my report as out of scope.
examples.hi: उन्होंने मेरी report को out of scope बताकर बंद कर दिया।

examples.en: Read the policy so you don't test out-of-scope hosts.
examples.hi: Policy पढ़ें ताकि आप out-of-scope hosts test न करें।

common_mistake.wrong: This asset is out of the scope of program.
common_mistake.right: This asset is out of scope for the program.
common_mistake.why: Fixed phrase 'out of scope'; add 'for the program', and use an article before 'program'.

cloze.sentence: They rejected the report because the host was ____.

en_def: included in what is allowed to be tested or reported
hi_def: जो test या report करने की अनुमति में शामिल है
hi_nuance: Fixed phrase; no article. Always confirm a target is in scope before testing.

examples.en: The main API is in scope.
examples.hi: मुख्य API in scope है।

examples.en: Only the listed domains are in scope.
examples.hi: सिर्फ़ सूचीबद्ध domains in scope हैं।

examples.en: Confirm the endpoint is in scope before testing.
examples.hi: Testing से पहले पुष्टि करें कि endpoint in scope है।

examples.en: This finding is in scope and valid.
examples.hi: यह finding in scope और valid है।

examples.en: Mobile apps became in scope last month.
examples.hi: पिछले महीने mobile apps in scope हो गए।

common_mistake.wrong: Is this domain coming in the scope?
common_mistake.right: Is this domain in scope?
common_mistake.why: Use the fixed phrase 'in scope' without 'coming in the'.

cloze.sentence: Check the policy to see whether the target is ____.

en_def: a report of an issue that has already been reported by someone else
hi_def: किसी समस्या की report जो पहले ही किसी और ने कर दी है
hi_nuance: In bug bounty, being marked 'duplicate' means no reward. Noun stress: DU-pli-cate; verb: du-pli-CATE.

examples.en: My report was closed as a duplicate.
examples.hi: मेरी report को duplicate बताकर बंद कर दिया गया।

examples.en: This looks like a duplicate of ticket 412.
examples.hi: यह ticket 412 का duplicate लगता है।

examples.en: Duplicates are common on popular programs.
examples.hi: लोकप्रिय programs पर duplicates आम हैं।

examples.en: They confirmed it was not a duplicate.
examples.hi: उन्होंने पुष्टि की कि यह duplicate नहीं था।

examples.en: Search existing reports to avoid duplicates.
examples.hi: Duplicates से बचने के लिए मौजूदा reports खोजें।

common_mistake.wrong: They marked my report duplicate only.
common_mistake.right: They marked my report as a duplicate.
common_mistake.why: Use 'as a duplicate'; drop the filler 'only'.

cloze.sentence: Because someone reported it yesterday, mine was closed as a ____.

en_def: in bug bounty, a report that gives useful information but is not a rewarded vulnerability
hi_def: bug bounty में, ऐसी report जो उपयोगी जानकारी देती है पर पुरस्कार योग्य vulnerability नहीं है
hi_nuance: A status label. 'marked as informative' means acknowledged but not paid. General meaning is 'giving information'.

examples.en: The triager marked it informative, not a bug.
examples.hi: Triager ने इसे informative बताया, bug नहीं।

examples.en: An informative report can still build reputation.
examples.hi: एक informative report फिर भी प्रतिष्ठा बना सकती है।

examples.en: Low-impact findings are often informative.
examples.hi: कम-impact findings अक्सर informative होती हैं।

examples.en: The session was very informative.
examples.hi: यह session बहुत informative था।

examples.en: They downgraded it from low to informative.
examples.hi: उन्होंने इसे low से घटाकर informative कर दिया।

common_mistake.wrong: They gave informative to my report.
common_mistake.right: They marked my report as informative.
common_mistake.why: Use 'marked ... as informative'; 'gave informative' is ungrammatical.

cloze.sentence: It was accurate but low impact, so they closed it as ____.

en_def: an alert that reports a problem which does not actually exist
hi_def: एक alert जो ऐसी समस्या बताता है जो असल में मौजूद नहीं है
hi_nuance: Opposite is 'false negative' (a real issue missed). Scanners produce many false positives.

examples.en: The scanner flagged it, but it was a false positive.
examples.hi: Scanner ने इसे flag किया, पर यह false positive था।

examples.en: We tune the rules to reduce false positives.
examples.hi: False positives घटाने के लिए हम rules tune करते हैं।

examples.en: Always verify a finding is not a false positive.
examples.hi: हमेशा जाँचें कि finding false positive तो नहीं है।

examples.en: Too many false positives waste the team's time.
examples.hi: बहुत सारे false positives team का समय बर्बाद करते हैं।

examples.en: This alert is a false positive caused by a redirect.
examples.hi: यह alert एक redirect की वजह से false positive है।

common_mistake.wrong: This is false positive, no need to worry.
common_mistake.right: This is a false positive, so there is no need to worry.
common_mistake.why: Use the article 'a'; join the clause properly.

cloze.sentence: After manual testing, we confirmed the scanner alert was a ____.

en_def: so small that it is not worth considering
hi_def: इतना कम कि विचार करने लायक भी न हो
hi_nuance: Useful to describe low impact or risk in reports. Do not confuse with 'negligent' (careless).

examples.en: The impact is negligible because no data is exposed.
examples.hi: Impact negligible है क्योंकि कोई data expose नहीं होता।

examples.en: The performance cost of the fix is negligible.
examples.hi: Fix की performance लागत negligible है।

examples.en: The risk is negligible on internal networks.
examples.hi: Internal networks पर जोखिम negligible है।

examples.en: A negligible number of users are affected.
examples.hi: बहुत कम, negligible संख्या में users प्रभावित हैं।

examples.en: The difference is negligible in practice.
examples.hi: व्यवहार में अंतर negligible है।

common_mistake.wrong: The impact is negligent in this case.
common_mistake.right: The impact is negligible in this case.
common_mistake.why: 'negligent' means careless; 'negligible' means very small.

cloze.sentence: Since only public data is shown, the risk is ____.

en_def: extremely serious; the highest severity level
hi_def: अत्यंत गंभीर; सबसे ऊँचा severity स्तर
hi_nuance: 'critical' is a severity rating (above high). Reserve it for issues with severe, easy-to-exploit impact.

examples.en: This is a critical remote code execution bug.
examples.hi: यह एक critical remote code execution bug है।

examples.en: Critical findings must be fixed immediately.
examples.hi: Critical findings तुरंत ठीक होनी चाहिए।

examples.en: We rated it critical due to full data access.
examples.hi: पूरे data access की वजह से हमने इसे critical रखा।

examples.en: A critical CVE was published today.
examples.hi: आज एक critical CVE प्रकाशित हुई।

examples.en: Only two findings were critical.
examples.hi: सिर्फ़ दो findings critical थीं।

common_mistake.wrong: This bug is too much critical.
common_mistake.right: This bug is critical.
common_mistake.why: 'too much critical' is not standard; 'critical' is already the top rating.

cloze.sentence: Because it allows full server takeover, the severity is ____.

en_def: something that must be true or in place before something else can happen
hi_def: कोई ऐसी शर्त जो किसी और चीज़ के होने से पहले पूरी होनी चाहिए
hi_nuance: In reports, listing prerequisites (e.g. 'requires a valid account') affects severity honestly.

examples.en: A valid session is a prerequisite for this attack.
examples.hi: इस हमले के लिए एक valid session prerequisite है।

examples.en: The only prerequisite is network access.
examples.hi: एकमात्र prerequisite network access है।

examples.en: List all prerequisites in the report.
examples.hi: Report में सभी prerequisites सूचीबद्ध करें।

examples.en: Without this prerequisite, exploitation fails.
examples.hi: इस prerequisite के बिना exploitation विफल हो जाता है।

examples.en: Admin access is a strong prerequisite that lowers severity.
examples.hi: Admin access एक बड़ी prerequisite है जो severity घटाती है।

common_mistake.wrong: The pre-requisite for this attack is one login.
common_mistake.right: The prerequisite for this attack is a valid login.
common_mistake.why: One word, no hyphen; use an article ('a valid login').

cloze.sentence: Having a low-privileged account is a ____ for this exploit.

en_def: not logged in or identity not verified
hi_def: जो logged in न हो या जिसकी पहचान सत्यापित न हो
hi_nuance: An 'unauthenticated' attack (no login needed) is more severe. Opposite: 'authenticated'.

examples.en: An unauthenticated user can read all invoices.
examples.hi: एक unauthenticated user सभी invoices पढ़ सकता है।

examples.en: The endpoint is reachable while unauthenticated.
examples.hi: यह endpoint unauthenticated रहते हुए भी पहुँच योग्य है।

examples.en: Unauthenticated RCE is worst-case severity.
examples.hi: Unauthenticated RCE सबसे ख़राब severity है।

examples.en: The API allows unauthenticated access to admin routes.
examples.hi: API admin routes तक unauthenticated access देता है।

examples.en: This is exploitable by an unauthenticated attacker.
examples.hi: यह एक unauthenticated हमलावर द्वारा exploit किया जा सकता है।

common_mistake.wrong: Any un-authenticate user can access this.
common_mistake.right: Any unauthenticated user can access this.
common_mistake.why: One word; use the adjective form 'unauthenticated'.

cloze.sentence: The severity is high because an ____ attacker can trigger it.

en_def: chosen freely by the attacker, without restriction
hi_def: जो हमलावर बिना किसी रोक के अपनी मर्ज़ी से चुन सके
hi_nuance: Key phrases: 'arbitrary file read', 'arbitrary code execution'. Shows the attacker's freedom, raising severity.

examples.en: The flaw allows arbitrary file read.
examples.hi: यह flaw arbitrary file read की अनुमति देता है।

examples.en: An attacker can run arbitrary commands.
examples.hi: एक हमलावर arbitrary commands चला सकता है।

examples.en: It permits writing to an arbitrary path.
examples.hi: यह arbitrary path पर लिखने की अनुमति देता है।

examples.en: Arbitrary redirect to any URL is possible.
examples.hi: किसी भी URL पर arbitrary redirect संभव है।

examples.en: The bug enables arbitrary object access.
examples.hi: यह bug arbitrary object access सक्षम करता है।

common_mistake.wrong: Attacker can read any arbitrary the files.
common_mistake.right: An attacker can read arbitrary files.
common_mistake.why: Drop 'the'; 'arbitrary files' already means any files.

cloze.sentence: Path traversal here allows ____ file read on the server.

en_def: very easily, with little effort
hi_def: बहुत आसानी से, बहुत कम मेहनत में
hi_nuance: Used to stress how easy an attack is: 'trivially exploitable'. Raises perceived severity.

examples.en: The token can be guessed trivially.
examples.hi: Token को trivially अनुमान लगाया जा सकता है।

examples.en: This filter is trivially bypassed.
examples.hi: यह filter trivially bypass हो जाता है।

examples.en: The bug is trivially exploitable from the browser.
examples.hi: यह bug browser से trivially exploit होने योग्य है।

examples.en: An attacker can trivially enumerate all users.
examples.hi: एक हमलावर सभी users को trivially enumerate कर सकता है।

examples.en: The secret is trivially recovered from the JS bundle.
examples.hi: यह secret JS bundle से trivially recover हो जाता है।

common_mistake.wrong: This can be exploit trivially by anyone.
common_mistake.right: This can be exploited trivially by anyone.
common_mistake.why: Use the past participle 'exploited' after 'be'.

cloze.sentence: Because the ID is sequential, accounts can be ____ enumerated.

en_def: requiring real effort or skill; not simple
hi_def: जिसमें असली मेहनत या कौशल लगे; आसान नहीं
hi_nuance: Useful when honestly describing effort: 'non-trivial to exploit' lowers likelihood in a fair report.

examples.en: Exploitation is non-trivial but possible.
examples.hi: Exploitation non-trivial है पर संभव है।

examples.en: The fix is non-trivial and needs a redesign.
examples.hi: Fix non-trivial है और redesign माँगता है।

examples.en: It took a non-trivial amount of time.
examples.hi: इसमें non-trivial समय लगा।

examples.en: The bypass required non-trivial reverse engineering.
examples.hi: इस bypass में non-trivial reverse engineering लगी।

examples.en: A non-trivial prerequisite reduces the risk.
examples.hi: एक non-trivial prerequisite जोखिम घटाती है।

common_mistake.wrong: The exploitation is non trivial task.
common_mistake.right: Exploitation is a non-trivial task.
common_mistake.why: Hyphenate 'non-trivial' and add the article 'a'.

cloze.sentence: The attack works, though it requires ____ setup.

en_def: to combine several vulnerabilities so they work together
hi_def: कई vulnerabilities को इस तरह जोड़ना कि वे मिलकर काम करें
hi_nuance: Verb here; the noun form is 'exploit chain'. 'chain A with B' or 'chain A and B together'.

examples.en: I chained the CSRF with the IDOR for full takeover.
examples.hi: मैंने पूरे takeover के लिए CSRF को IDOR के साथ chain किया।

examples.en: Chaining these two bugs increases the impact.
examples.hi: इन दो bugs को chain करने से impact बढ़ता है।

examples.en: You can chain the open redirect into an SSRF.
examples.hi: आप open redirect को एक SSRF में chain कर सकते हैं।

examples.en: The report shows how the bugs chain together.
examples.hi: Report दिखाती है कि ये bugs कैसे आपस में chain होते हैं।

examples.en: Do not chain out-of-scope hosts.
examples.hi: Out-of-scope hosts को chain न करें।

common_mistake.wrong: I chained the both bugs for more impact.
common_mistake.right: I chained both bugs for more impact.
common_mistake.why: Say 'both bugs', not 'the both bugs'.

cloze.sentence: You can ____ the open redirect with the token leak to hijack sessions.

en_def: to move from one compromised system to reach others on a network
hi_def: एक compromised सिस्टम से आगे बढ़कर network के दूसरे systems तक पहुँचना
hi_nuance: Post-exploitation term. 'pivot to' / 'pivot through'. Different from 'lateral movement' (broader concept).

examples.en: From the web server, I could pivot to the database host.
examples.hi: Web server से मैं database host तक pivot कर सका।

examples.en: The attacker pivots through the jump box.
examples.hi: हमलावर jump box के ज़रिये pivot करता है।

examples.en: We stopped the pivot at the network boundary.
examples.hi: हमने network boundary पर pivot रोका।

examples.en: Segmentation makes it hard to pivot.
examples.hi: Segmentation pivot करना कठिन बनाता है।

examples.en: Once inside, they pivoted to the finance subnet.
examples.hi: अंदर पहुँचते ही उन्होंने finance subnet तक pivot किया।

common_mistake.wrong: The attacker pivot to internal network.
common_mistake.right: The attacker pivoted to the internal network.
common_mistake.why: Past tense 'pivoted' and article 'the internal network'.

cloze.sentence: After gaining a foothold, the attacker can ____ to other hosts.

en_def: moving across a network from one system to another after breaking in
hi_def: घुसने के बाद network में एक सिस्टम से दूसरे तक फैलना
hi_nuance: Uncountable. Detected by monitoring internal traffic. Broader than a single 'pivot'.

examples.en: Weak internal passwords enabled lateral movement.
examples.hi: कमज़ोर internal passwords ने lateral movement संभव बनाई।

examples.en: Network segmentation limits lateral movement.
examples.hi: Network segmentation lateral movement को सीमित करती है।

examples.en: We detected lateral movement in the logs.
examples.hi: हमने logs में lateral movement का पता लगाया।

examples.en: Lateral movement let them reach the domain controller.
examples.hi: Lateral movement से वे domain controller तक पहुँच गए।

examples.en: Stopping lateral movement contains the breach.
examples.hi: Lateral movement रोकना breach को सीमित करता है।

common_mistake.wrong: The attacker did lateral movements across servers.
common_mistake.right: The attacker performed lateral movement across servers.
common_mistake.why: Usually uncountable; use 'performed lateral movement'.

cloze.sentence: Segmenting the network prevents easy ____ between hosts.

en_def: to list or discover items one by one, such as users or endpoints
hi_def: एक-एक करके चीज़ें खोजना या सूचीबद्ध करना, जैसे users या endpoints
hi_nuance: 'user enumeration' is a common finding: the app reveals whether a username exists. Verb takes a direct object.

examples.en: The login page lets me enumerate valid usernames.
examples.hi: Login page मुझे valid usernames enumerate करने देता है।

examples.en: I enumerated the API endpoints from the JS files.
examples.hi: मैंने JS files से API endpoints enumerate किए।

examples.en: Sequential IDs make it easy to enumerate records.
examples.hi: Sequential IDs records को enumerate करना आसान बनाते हैं।

examples.en: The error message helped me enumerate accounts.
examples.hi: Error message ने मुझे accounts enumerate करने में मदद की।

examples.en: Rate limiting slows down enumeration.
examples.hi: Rate limiting enumeration को धीमा करता है।

common_mistake.wrong: I can enumerate about all the users.
common_mistake.right: I can enumerate all the users.
common_mistake.why: 'enumerate' is transitive; drop 'about'.

cloze.sentence: Different error messages let an attacker ____ registered emails.

en_def: to report a vulnerability privately and give time to fix it before going public
hi_def: किसी vulnerability को निजी रूप से report करना और सार्वजनिक होने से पहले उसे ठीक करने का समय देना
hi_nuance: Related noun phrase: 'responsible disclosure'. The opposite is 'full/immediate disclosure'.

examples.en: I always disclose responsibly to the vendor first.
examples.hi: मैं हमेशा पहले vendor को responsibly disclose करता हूँ।

examples.en: Please disclose responsibly and avoid public tweets.
examples.hi: कृपया responsibly disclose करें और सार्वजनिक tweets से बचें।

examples.en: Researchers who disclose responsibly build trust.
examples.hi: जो researchers responsibly disclose करते हैं वे भरोसा बनाते हैं।

examples.en: We ask everyone to disclose responsibly.
examples.hi: हम सबसे responsibly disclose करने का अनुरोध करते हैं।

examples.en: Disclosing responsibly protects real users.
examples.hi: Responsibly disclose करना असली users की रक्षा करता है।

common_mistake.wrong: Kindly disclose the bug in a responsible way to public.
common_mistake.right: Please disclose the bug responsibly, and not to the public first.
common_mistake.why: Use the adverb 'responsibly'; avoid 'kindly'; public disclosure comes after the fix.

cloze.sentence: Ethical hackers ____, giving the vendor time before any public post.

en_def: a process where researcher and vendor agree on when to reveal a fixed vulnerability
hi_def: एक प्रक्रिया जिसमें researcher और vendor तय करते हैं कि ठीक की गई vulnerability कब सार्वजनिक करनी है
hi_nuance: Modern preferred term over 'responsible disclosure'. Often involves an agreed timeline and an embargo.

examples.en: We follow a coordinated disclosure policy.
examples.hi: हम एक coordinated disclosure policy का पालन करते हैं।

examples.en: Coordinated disclosure set a 90-day timeline.
examples.hi: Coordinated disclosure ने 90-दिन की timeline तय की।

examples.en: The advisory was published after coordinated disclosure.
examples.hi: Advisory coordinated disclosure के बाद प्रकाशित हुई।

examples.en: Coordinated disclosure balances users and researchers.
examples.hi: Coordinated disclosure users और researchers के बीच संतुलन बनाती है।

examples.en: They thanked me for coordinated disclosure.
examples.hi: उन्होंने coordinated disclosure के लिए मुझे धन्यवाद दिया।

common_mistake.wrong: We did co-ordinate disclosure with the vendor.
common_mistake.right: We followed coordinated disclosure with the vendor.
common_mistake.why: Use the adjective 'coordinated' (one word) and the verb 'followed'.

cloze.sentence: Under ____, both sides agree on a public release date.

en_def: an agreed period during which information must not be published
hi_def: एक तय अवधि जिसके दौरान जानकारी प्रकाशित नहीं की जानी चाहिए
hi_nuance: In disclosure, 'under embargo' means keep it secret until the agreed date. Plural adds -es: embargoes.

examples.en: The details are under embargo until the patch ships.
examples.hi: Patch आने तक details embargo के तहत हैं।

examples.en: We agreed to a two-week embargo.
examples.hi: हमने दो-हफ़्ते के embargo पर सहमति दी।

examples.en: Breaking the embargo would put users at risk.
examples.hi: Embargo तोड़ना users को जोखिम में डाल देगा।

examples.en: The advisory lifts when the embargo ends.
examples.hi: Embargo ख़त्म होते ही advisory सार्वजनिक हो जाती है।

examples.en: Please respect the embargo on this finding.
examples.hi: कृपया इस finding पर embargo का सम्मान करें।

common_mistake.wrong: The finding is in embargo till next week.
common_mistake.right: The finding is under embargo until next week.
common_mistake.why: Fixed phrase 'under embargo'; use 'until' for time.

cloze.sentence: Do not tweet about it; the report is still under ____.

en_def: a temporary solution used until a proper fix is available
hi_def: एक अस्थायी समाधान जिसे सही fix आने तक इस्तेमाल किया जाता है
hi_nuance: One word as a noun. A workaround reduces risk now; remediation removes it later.

examples.en: As a workaround, disable the endpoint temporarily.
examples.hi: एक workaround के रूप में, endpoint को अस्थायी रूप से बंद करें।

examples.en: The workaround holds until the next release.
examples.hi: यह workaround अगली release तक चलेगा।

examples.en: We suggested a workaround in the report.
examples.hi: हमने report में एक workaround सुझाया।

examples.en: A firewall rule is a good short-term workaround.
examples.hi: Firewall rule एक अच्छा अल्पकालिक workaround है।

examples.en: The workaround is not a permanent fix.
examples.hi: Workaround कोई स्थायी fix नहीं है।

common_mistake.wrong: Please give some work around for now.
common_mistake.right: Please suggest a workaround for now.
common_mistake.why: As a noun it is one word 'workaround'; use 'a workaround'.

cloze.sentence: Until the patch, block the header as a ____.

en_def: an alternative safeguard used when the ideal fix is not possible
hi_def: एक वैकल्पिक सुरक्षा उपाय जब आदर्श fix संभव न हो
hi_nuance: Common in compliance and audits. It reduces risk without removing the underlying weakness.

examples.en: Network isolation is a compensating control here.
examples.hi: यहाँ network isolation एक compensating control है।

examples.en: They added a compensating control instead of a code fix.
examples.hi: उन्होंने code fix के बजाय एक compensating control जोड़ा।

examples.en: The auditor accepted the compensating control.
examples.hi: Auditor ने compensating control स्वीकार किया।

examples.en: A compensating control lowers but does not remove the risk.
examples.hi: Compensating control जोखिम घटाता है पर हटाता नहीं।

examples.en: Document each compensating control clearly.
examples.hi: हर compensating control को साफ़ document करें।

common_mistake.wrong: We put compensatory control for the risk.
common_mistake.right: We put a compensating control in place for the risk.
common_mistake.why: The standard term is 'compensating control'; add 'in place'.

cloze.sentence: Since the legacy app cannot be changed, we rely on a ____.

en_def: using multiple layers of security so one failure does not break everything
hi_def: सुरक्षा की कई परतें रखना ताकि एक विफलता से सब कुछ न टूटे
hi_nuance: British spelling 'defence in depth' is also fine. It is a strategy, not a single control.

examples.en: Defense in depth adds layers behind the firewall.
examples.hi: Defense in depth firewall के पीछे और परतें जोड़ता है।

examples.en: With defense in depth, one bug is not fatal.
examples.hi: Defense in depth के साथ, एक bug घातक नहीं होता।

examples.en: We recommend defense in depth, not a single control.
examples.hi: हम एक अकेले control नहीं, defense in depth की सलाह देते हैं।

examples.en: Logging is one layer of defense in depth.
examples.hi: Logging defense in depth की एक परत है।

examples.en: Defense in depth slowed the attacker down.
examples.hi: Defense in depth ने हमलावर को धीमा किया।

common_mistake.wrong: We should do defense in depth strategy.
common_mistake.right: We should adopt a defense-in-depth strategy.
common_mistake.why: Hyphenate when used as an adjective; use 'adopt'.

cloze.sentence: Multiple overlapping controls are the idea behind ____.

en_def: the principle of giving each account only the access it truly needs
hi_def: हर account को सिर्फ़ उतनी access देने का सिद्धांत जितनी सच में ज़रूरत हो
hi_nuance: Fixed phrase 'principle of least privilege' (PoLP). No article inside the phrase.

examples.en: Apply least privilege to all service accounts.
examples.hi: सभी service accounts पर least privilege लागू करें।

examples.en: Least privilege would have limited this breach.
examples.hi: Least privilege इस breach को सीमित कर देता।

examples.en: The role violates least privilege.
examples.hi: यह role least privilege का उल्लंघन करता है।

examples.en: Least privilege reduces the blast radius.
examples.hi: Least privilege नुक़सान का दायरा घटाता है।

examples.en: We audit permissions against least privilege.
examples.hi: हम permissions को least privilege के हिसाब से audit करते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: We follow the least of privilege here.
common_mistake.right: We follow least privilege here.
common_mistake.why: The phrase is 'least privilege', not 'least of privilege'.

cloze.sentence: Grant only the access each role needs, following ____.

en_def: to take advantage of a vulnerability to attack a system
hi_def: किसी vulnerability का फ़ायदा उठाकर सिस्टम पर हमला करना
hi_nuance: Verb stress: ex-PLOIT; noun stress: EX-ploit. As a noun it means the attack code itself.

examples.en: An attacker can exploit this without a password.
examples.hi: एक हमलावर बिना password के इसे exploit कर सकता है।

examples.en: The public exploit works on version 1.2.
examples.hi: यह सार्वजनिक exploit version 1.2 पर काम करता है।

examples.en: I wrote a small script to exploit the flaw.
examples.hi: मैंने इस flaw को exploit करने के लिए एक छोटा script लिखा।

examples.en: The bug is hard to exploit in practice.
examples.hi: इस bug को व्यवहार में exploit करना कठिन है।

examples.en: They patched it before an exploit appeared.
examples.hi: Exploit आने से पहले उन्होंने इसे patch कर दिया।

common_mistake.wrong: The hacker exploited on the weak API.
common_mistake.right: The hacker exploited the weak API.
common_mistake.why: 'exploit' is transitive; do not add 'on'.

cloze.sentence: Without input checks, an attacker can ____ the search field.

en_def: a possible danger that could harm a system
hi_def: एक संभावित ख़तरा जो किसी सिस्टम को नुक़सान पहुँचा सकता है
hi_nuance: Threat, vulnerability, and risk are different: threat is the danger, vulnerability is the weakness, risk is the combination.

examples.en: Insider misuse is a real threat here.
examples.hi: Insider दुरुपयोग यहाँ एक असली threat है।

examples.en: We built a threat model for the new feature.
examples.hi: हमने नए feature के लिए एक threat model बनाया।

examples.en: The biggest threat is credential theft.
examples.hi: सबसे बड़ा threat credential चोरी है।

examples.en: This control addresses several threats.
examples.hi: यह control कई threats से निपटता है।

examples.en: Threat actors often reuse old exploits.
examples.hi: Threat actors अक्सर पुराने exploits दोबारा इस्तेमाल करते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: This is a big threat for the users data.
common_mistake.right: This is a serious threat to the users' data.
common_mistake.why: 'threat to', not 'threat for'; add the possessive apostrophe.

cloze.sentence: Phishing remains the top ____ to most organisations.

en_def: the chance and impact of something bad happening
hi_def: किसी बुरी घटना के होने की संभावना और उसका असर
hi_nuance: 'risk of' + noun/-ing. Reports often say 'accept the risk' or 'the residual risk'.

examples.en: The risk of data loss is high.
examples.hi: Data loss का risk ऊँचा है।

examples.en: Management chose to accept the risk.
examples.hi: Management ने risk स्वीकार करने का फ़ैसला किया।

examples.en: This control lowers the residual risk.
examples.hi: यह control residual risk घटाता है।

examples.en: We rank findings by risk.
examples.hi: हम findings को risk के आधार पर रैंक करते हैं।

examples.en: There is a risk of the token being reused.
examples.hi: Token के दोबारा इस्तेमाल होने का risk है।

common_mistake.wrong: There is risk for losing the data.
common_mistake.right: There is a risk of losing the data.
common_mistake.why: Use 'a risk of + -ing', not 'risk for'.

cloze.sentence: Leaving the port open increases the ____ of compromise.

en_def: anything valuable that needs protecting, such as data or a server
hi_def: कोई भी मूल्यवान चीज़ जिसकी रक्षा ज़रूरी है, जैसे data या server
hi_nuance: 'asset inventory' is knowing what you own. You cannot protect an asset you do not know about.

examples.en: The customer database is our most valuable asset.
examples.hi: Customer database हमारी सबसे मूल्यवान asset है।

examples.en: Keep an up-to-date asset inventory.
examples.hi: एक अद्यतन asset inventory रखें।

examples.en: Every asset should have an owner.
examples.hi: हर asset का एक owner होना चाहिए।

examples.en: The forgotten server was an unmanaged asset.
examples.hi: वह भूला हुआ server एक unmanaged asset था।

examples.en: We classify assets by sensitivity.
examples.hi: हम assets को संवेदनशीलता के आधार पर वर्गीकृत करते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: We have many assets which are not in the list.
common_mistake.right: We have many assets that are not in the inventory.
common_mistake.why: Use 'that' for a defining clause; 'inventory' is the precise term.

cloze.sentence: You cannot protect an ____ you do not know you own.

en_def: an action or control taken to prevent or reduce an attack
hi_def: किसी हमले को रोकने या घटाने के लिए किया गया उपाय या control
hi_nuance: One word. Similar to 'control' and 'safeguard'. Countable: 'a countermeasure', 'several countermeasures'.

examples.en: Multi-factor auth is an effective countermeasure.
examples.hi: Multi-factor auth एक प्रभावी countermeasure है।

examples.en: We deployed countermeasures against brute-force.
examples.hi: हमने brute-force के ख़िलाफ़ countermeasures लगाए।

examples.en: The report lists countermeasures for each finding.
examples.hi: Report हर finding के लिए countermeasures सूचीबद्ध करती है।

examples.en: No single countermeasure is enough.
examples.hi: कोई एक अकेला countermeasure काफ़ी नहीं है।

examples.en: Rate limiting is a cheap countermeasure.
examples.hi: Rate limiting एक सस्ता countermeasure है।

common_mistake.wrong: We took counter measures for the attack.
common_mistake.right: We took countermeasures against the attack.
common_mistake.why: One word 'countermeasures'; use 'against', not 'for'.

cloze.sentence: Locking accounts after five tries is a simple ____.

en_def: the process of proving who a user is
hi_def: यह साबित करने की प्रक्रिया कि कोई user कौन है
hi_nuance: Authentication (who you are) is not authorization (what you can do). Often shortened to 'authn'.

examples.en: Authentication is broken on this endpoint.
examples.hi: इस endpoint पर authentication टूटा हुआ है।

examples.en: Two-factor authentication blocks stolen passwords.
examples.hi: Two-factor authentication चुराए गए passwords को रोकता है।

examples.en: The API skips authentication for GET requests.
examples.hi: API, GET requests के लिए authentication छोड़ देता है।

examples.en: Weak authentication led to account takeover.
examples.hi: कमज़ोर authentication ने account takeover करा दिया।

examples.en: Authentication should happen before authorization.
examples.hi: Authentication, authorization से पहले होना चाहिए।

common_mistake.wrong: The authentication is not there for this API.
common_mistake.right: This API has no authentication.
common_mistake.why: 'is not there' is an Indianism; say 'has no authentication'.

cloze.sentence: The endpoint responds even without ____, so anyone can call it.

en_def: the process of deciding what an authenticated user is allowed to do
hi_def: यह तय करने की प्रक्रिया कि एक authenticated user को क्या करने की अनुमति है
hi_nuance: Often shortened to 'authz'. 'Broken access control' is an authorization failure. British spelling 'authorisation'.

examples.en: Authorization checks are missing on the delete route.
examples.hi: Delete route पर authorization checks नहीं हैं।

examples.en: A user accessed admin data due to weak authorization.
examples.hi: कमज़ोर authorization की वजह से एक user ने admin data देखा।

examples.en: Authorization must be enforced on the server.
examples.hi: Authorization server पर लागू होना चाहिए।

examples.en: The IDOR is an authorization flaw.
examples.hi: यह IDOR एक authorization flaw है।

examples.en: Authentication passed but authorization failed.
examples.hi: Authentication पास हुआ पर authorization विफल रहा।

common_mistake.wrong: There is authorization issue, normal user can see admin page.
common_mistake.right: There is an authorization issue: a normal user can see the admin page.
common_mistake.why: Add the article 'an' and the article 'the admin page'.

cloze.sentence: The server checks who you are but not what you may do, so ____ is broken.

en_def: information used to prove identity, such as a username and password
hi_def: पहचान साबित करने के लिए इस्तेमाल की जाने वाली जानकारी, जैसे username और password
hi_nuance: Usually plural: 'credentials'. 'credential stuffing' is reusing leaked login pairs.

examples.en: The credentials were hard-coded in the app.
examples.hi: Credentials app में hard-coded थे।

examples.en: Never log credentials in plain text.
examples.hi: Credentials को कभी plain text में log न करें।

examples.en: Credential stuffing succeeded on reused passwords.
examples.hi: दोबारा इस्तेमाल किए passwords पर credential stuffing सफल हुआ।

examples.en: Rotate the leaked credentials immediately.
examples.hi: Leaked credentials तुरंत बदलें।

examples.en: The API accepted default credentials.
examples.hi: API ने default credentials स्वीकार किए।

common_mistake.wrong: The credential is exposed in the JS file.
common_mistake.right: The credentials are exposed in the JS file.
common_mistake.why: Usually plural 'credentials ... are'.

cloze.sentence: The mobile app stores admin ____ in plain text.

en_def: a period in which a user stays logged in, tracked by a token or cookie
hi_def: वह अवधि जिसमें user logged in रहता है, जिसे token या cookie से track किया जाता है
hi_nuance: 'session fixation' and 'session hijacking' are common findings. A session should end (expire) after logout.

examples.en: The session does not expire after logout.
examples.hi: Logout के बाद भी session expire नहीं होता।

examples.en: I hijacked the session using the leaked cookie.
examples.hi: मैंने leaked cookie से session hijack किया।

examples.en: Sessions should be invalidated on password change.
examples.hi: Password बदलने पर sessions invalidate होने चाहिए।

examples.en: The session token is predictable.
examples.hi: Session token अनुमान लगाने योग्य है।

examples.en: One user can steal another user's session.
examples.hi: एक user दूसरे user का session चुरा सकता है।

common_mistake.wrong: After logout also the session is working.
common_mistake.right: The session stays valid even after logout.
common_mistake.why: Rephrase; 'after logout also' is an Indianism for 'even after logout'.

cloze.sentence: Because the cookie never expires, the ____ can be reused for days.

en_def: a string that proves identity or grants access, used instead of a password each time
hi_def: एक string जो पहचान साबित करती है या access देती है, हर बार password के बजाय इस्तेमाल होती है
hi_nuance: 'access token', 'CSRF token', 'JWT'. A predictable or non-expiring token is a finding.

examples.en: The access token is exposed in the URL.
examples.hi: Access token URL में expose है।

examples.en: The token never expires, which is a risk.
examples.hi: Token कभी expire नहीं होता, जो एक risk है।

examples.en: A missing CSRF token allows forged requests.
examples.hi: CSRF token न होने से forged requests संभव हैं।

examples.en: The JWT can be tampered with because it is not signed.
examples.hi: JWT sign न होने से उसके साथ tamper किया जा सकता है।

examples.en: Rotate the token after any suspected leak.
examples.hi: किसी भी संदिग्ध leak के बाद token rotate करें।

common_mistake.wrong: The token is coming in the URL which is not good.
common_mistake.right: The token appears in the URL, which is insecure.
common_mistake.why: Use 'appears'; 'which is not good' is vague, prefer 'insecure'.

cloze.sentence: Putting the auth ____ in the query string leaks it into server logs.

en_def: an attack where malicious data is inserted so a system runs it as a command
hi_def: एक हमला जिसमें दुर्भावनापूर्ण data इस तरह डाला जाता है कि सिस्टम उसे command की तरह चला दे
hi_nuance: 'SQL injection', 'command injection'. The verb is 'inject'. Caused by mixing data with code.

examples.en: The search field is open to SQL injection.
examples.hi: Search field SQL injection के लिए खुला है।

examples.en: Command injection let me run shell commands.
examples.hi: Command injection ने मुझे shell commands चलाने दिए।

examples.en: Parameterized queries prevent injection.
examples.hi: Parameterized queries injection रोकती हैं।

examples.en: The header is vulnerable to injection.
examples.hi: यह header injection के लिए vulnerable है।

examples.en: Injection remains a top web risk.
examples.hi: Injection आज भी एक शीर्ष web risk है।

common_mistake.wrong: This field is having SQL injection.
common_mistake.right: This field is vulnerable to SQL injection.
common_mistake.why: Avoid 'is having'; say 'is vulnerable to'.

cloze.sentence: Concatenating user input into a query enables SQL ____.

en_def: moving outside an allowed folder to reach files you should not access
hi_def: अनुमत folder से बाहर जाकर उन files तक पहुँचना जिन तक पहुँच नहीं होनी चाहिए
hi_nuance: 'path traversal' / 'directory traversal' uses '../' sequences. Fixed by validating and normalising paths.

examples.en: Path traversal let me read /etc/passwd.
examples.hi: Path traversal ने मुझे /etc/passwd पढ़ने दिया।

examples.en: The filename parameter allows directory traversal.
examples.hi: Filename parameter directory traversal की अनुमति देता है।

examples.en: Normalising the path stops traversal.
examples.hi: Path को normalise करना traversal रोकता है।

examples.en: Traversal exposed configuration files.
examples.hi: Traversal ने configuration files expose कीं।

examples.en: The '../' sequence signals traversal.
examples.hi: '../' sequence traversal का संकेत देती है।

common_mistake.wrong: The app is doing path traversal to attacker.
common_mistake.right: The app is vulnerable to path traversal.
common_mistake.why: The app does not 'do' traversal; it is 'vulnerable to' it.

cloze.sentence: Using '../../etc/passwd' in the path is classic directory ____.

en_def: the act of gaining higher access than intended
hi_def: इच्छित से अधिक access प्राप्त करने की क्रिया
hi_nuance: 'privilege escalation' can be vertical (user to admin) or horizontal (one user to another). The verb is 'escalate'.

examples.en: This is a vertical privilege escalation.
examples.hi: यह एक vertical privilege escalation है।

examples.en: Horizontal escalation let me read a peer's data.
examples.hi: Horizontal escalation ने मुझे एक peer का data पढ़ने दिया।

examples.en: The escalation needs a local account first.
examples.hi: इस escalation के लिए पहले एक local account चाहिए।

examples.en: We found an escalation path to root.
examples.hi: हमें root तक एक escalation path मिला।

examples.en: Escalation raised the severity to high.
examples.hi: Escalation ने severity को high कर दिया।

common_mistake.wrong: There is privilege escalation happening from user to admin.
common_mistake.right: There is a privilege escalation from a normal user to admin.
common_mistake.why: Add the article 'a'; 'happening' is unnecessary.

cloze.sentence: Reading another user's files at the same level is horizontal ____.

en_def: an attacker's ability to keep access even after a reboot or fix
hi_def: reboot या fix के बाद भी हमलावर की access बनाए रखने की क्षमता
hi_nuance: Post-exploitation term. A backdoor or scheduled task provides persistence. General meaning: 'not giving up'.

examples.en: The malware set up persistence via a cron job.
examples.hi: Malware ने cron job से persistence बना ली।

examples.en: We removed the attacker's persistence mechanism.
examples.hi: हमने हमलावर का persistence mechanism हटाया।

examples.en: Persistence lets them return after a reboot.
examples.hi: Persistence उन्हें reboot के बाद लौटने देती है।

examples.en: Check startup scripts for persistence.
examples.hi: Persistence के लिए startup scripts जाँचें।

examples.en: Without persistence, a reboot ends the access.
examples.hi: बिना persistence के, reboot access ख़त्म कर देता है।

common_mistake.wrong: The attacker did persistence in the server.
common_mistake.right: The attacker established persistence on the server.
common_mistake.why: Collocation is 'establish persistence'; use 'on the server'.

cloze.sentence: A hidden scheduled task gives the attacker ____ across reboots.

en_def: the unauthorised copying of data out of a system
hi_def: किसी सिस्टम से data को बिना अनुमति बाहर निकालना
hi_nuance: Often shortened to 'exfil'. The verb is 'exfiltrate'. Detected by watching outbound traffic.

examples.en: The attacker used DNS for data exfiltration.
examples.hi: हमलावर ने data exfiltration के लिए DNS का इस्तेमाल किया।

examples.en: Large uploads at night suggested exfiltration.
examples.hi: रात में बड़े uploads exfiltration का संकेत देते थे।

examples.en: We blocked the exfiltration channel.
examples.hi: हमने exfiltration channel को block किया।

examples.en: Encryption does not stop exfiltration by itself.
examples.hi: Encryption अकेले exfiltration नहीं रोकता।

examples.en: The report describes the exfiltration path.
examples.hi: Report exfiltration path का वर्णन करती है।

common_mistake.wrong: The data is exfiltrating out of the network.
common_mistake.right: The attacker is exfiltrating data from the network.
common_mistake.why: Data does not exfiltrate itself; name the actor.
