cloze.sentence: Sending stolen records over DNS is a stealthy ____ technique.

en_def: gathering information about a target before attacking
hi_def: हमले से पहले किसी target के बारे में जानकारी इकट्ठा करना
hi_nuance: Often shortened to 'recon'. Can be passive (no contact) or active (probing). Hard to spell; practise it.

examples.en: Recon revealed several forgotten subdomains.
examples.hi: Recon ने कई भूले हुए subdomains सामने लाए।

examples.en: Passive reconnaissance leaves no trace.
examples.hi: Passive reconnaissance कोई निशान नहीं छोड़ती।

examples.en: Good reconnaissance makes exploitation easier.
examples.hi: अच्छी reconnaissance exploitation को आसान बनाती है।

examples.en: We spent a day on reconnaissance.
examples.hi: हमने एक दिन reconnaissance पर लगाया।

examples.en: Reconnaissance found an exposed admin panel.
examples.hi: Reconnaissance ने एक exposed admin panel खोजा।

common_mistake.wrong: First we do the reconnaisance of the target.
common_mistake.right: First we perform reconnaissance on the target.
common_mistake.why: Spelling 'reconnaissance'; use 'perform reconnaissance on'.

cloze.sentence: Before any attack, an adversary starts with ____.

en_def: to identify the exact software or version a system is running
hi_def: यह पहचानना कि सिस्टम कौन-सा सॉफ़्टवेयर या version चला रहा है
hi_nuance: Both verb and noun. Version banners help attackers 'fingerprint' targets. Hide unnecessary version info.

examples.en: I could fingerprint the server as nginx 1.18.
examples.hi: मैं server को nginx 1.18 के रूप में fingerprint कर सका।

examples.en: The response headers fingerprint the framework.
examples.hi: Response headers framework को fingerprint करते हैं।

examples.en: Hiding the version makes fingerprinting harder.
examples.hi: Version छिपाना fingerprinting कठिन बनाता है।

examples.en: We fingerprinted every host in scope.
examples.hi: हमने scope के हर host को fingerprint किया।

examples.en: A unique error page helped me fingerprint the app.
examples.hi: एक अनोखे error page ने मुझे app fingerprint करने में मदद की।

common_mistake.wrong: From headers I fingerprint about the server version.
common_mistake.right: From the headers, I fingerprinted the server version.
common_mistake.why: 'fingerprint' is transitive; drop 'about' and use past tense.

cloze.sentence: Verbose banners let an attacker ____ the exact software version.

en_def: to try many values automatically until one works, such as passwords
hi_def: जब तक कोई काम न कर जाए तब तक अपने-आप कई मान आज़माना, जैसे passwords
hi_nuance: Hyphenated as a verb/adjective ('brute-force attack'). Countered by rate limiting and lockouts.

examples.en: Without rate limits, I can brute-force the PIN.
examples.hi: Rate limits के बिना, मैं PIN को brute-force कर सकता हूँ।

examples.en: The login has no protection against brute-forcing.
examples.hi: Login में brute-forcing के ख़िलाफ़ कोई सुरक्षा नहीं है।

examples.en: A four-digit code is trivial to brute-force.
examples.hi: चार-अंकों का code brute-force करना बहुत आसान है।

examples.en: Account lockout stops brute-force attacks.
examples.hi: Account lockout brute-force हमलों को रोकता है।

examples.en: We brute-forced the token space in minutes.
examples.hi: हमने कुछ मिनटों में token space को brute-force किया।

common_mistake.wrong: Attacker can brute force out the OTP.
common_mistake.right: An attacker can brute-force the OTP.
common_mistake.why: Hyphenate the verb; do not add 'out'; use an article.

cloze.sentence: With no lockout, a bot can ____ the six-digit code.

en_def: a cap on how many requests are allowed in a time period
hi_def: एक तय समय में कितनी requests की अनुमति है, उसकी सीमा
hi_nuance: Noun 'rate limit'; verb 'rate-limit'. Missing rate limits enable brute-force and enumeration.

examples.en: There is no rate limit on the OTP endpoint.
examples.hi: OTP endpoint पर कोई rate limit नहीं है।

examples.en: A rate limit would stop this abuse.
examples.hi: एक rate limit इस दुरुपयोग को रोक देता।

examples.en: The API hit its rate limit after 100 calls.
examples.hi: 100 calls के बाद API अपनी rate limit पर पहुँच गया।

examples.en: We recommend rate-limiting the login route.
examples.hi: हम login route को rate-limit करने की सलाह देते हैं।

examples.en: Weak rate limits allow slow enumeration.
examples.hi: कमज़ोर rate limits धीमी enumeration की अनुमति देती हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: There is no rate limiting is applied here.
common_mistake.right: No rate limiting is applied here.
common_mistake.why: Double verb; use one clean clause.

cloze.sentence: Because there is no ____, the code can be guessed endlessly.

en_def: to slow down or limit the rate of requests
hi_def: requests की गति को धीमा करना या सीमित करना
hi_nuance: Near-synonym of rate-limiting. 'throttle' can be gentler (slow down) than a hard block.

examples.en: The server should throttle repeated failures.
examples.hi: Server को बार-बार की failures को throttle करना चाहिए।

examples.en: We throttle each IP to ten requests per minute.
examples.hi: हम हर IP को प्रति मिनट दस requests पर throttle करते हैं।

examples.en: Throttling reduced the brute-force speed.
examples.hi: Throttling ने brute-force की गति घटाई।

examples.en: The endpoint is not throttled at all.
examples.hi: यह endpoint बिल्कुल throttle नहीं है।

examples.en: Throttle the API to protect the backend.
examples.hi: Backend की रक्षा के लिए API को throttle करें।

common_mistake.wrong: The API is not throttling the requests properly done.
common_mistake.right: The API does not throttle requests properly.
common_mistake.why: Remove 'done'; use simple present 'does not throttle'.

cloze.sentence: To resist automated abuse, ____ repeated login attempts.

en_def: a formal review to check security or compliance
hi_def: सुरक्षा या अनुपालन जाँचने के लिए एक औपचारिक समीक्षा
hi_nuance: Both noun and verb. 'audit log' is the record of who did what. 'audit trail' too.

examples.en: The annual audit found weak access controls.
examples.hi: वार्षिक audit ने कमज़ोर access controls पाए।

examples.en: Enable audit logs on the admin panel.
examples.hi: Admin panel पर audit logs चालू करें।

examples.en: We audit permissions every quarter.
examples.hi: हम हर तिमाही permissions audit करते हैं।

examples.en: The audit trail showed the deleted records.
examples.hi: Audit trail ने हटाए गए records दिखाए।

examples.en: There is no audit log for sensitive actions.
examples.hi: संवेदनशील actions के लिए कोई audit log नहीं है।

common_mistake.wrong: We did audit of the system last month.
common_mistake.right: We audited the system last month.
common_mistake.why: Use the verb 'audited', or 'did an audit of'.

cloze.sentence: Without an ____ log, we cannot tell who deleted the data.

en_def: a known-good standard used to compare against later
hi_def: एक ज्ञात-सही मानक जिससे बाद में तुलना की जाती है
hi_nuance: 'security baseline' is the minimum config every system must meet. Anomalies are deviations from baseline.

examples.en: Every server must meet the security baseline.
examples.hi: हर server को security baseline पूरी करनी होगी।

examples.en: We compared the host against the baseline.
examples.hi: हमने host की baseline से तुलना की।

examples.en: The baseline forbids default passwords.
examples.hi: Baseline default passwords पर रोक लगाती है।

examples.en: Deviations from the baseline are flagged.
examples.hi: Baseline से विचलन flag किए जाते हैं।

examples.en: Set a baseline before measuring improvement.
examples.hi: सुधार मापने से पहले एक baseline तय करें।

common_mistake.wrong: The server is not matching to the baseline.
common_mistake.right: The server does not match the baseline.
common_mistake.why: 'match' is transitive; drop 'to'.

cloze.sentence: Any config that differs from the ____ gets reviewed.

en_def: the overall security strength and readiness of an organisation
hi_def: किसी संगठन की समग्र सुरक्षा-शक्ति और तैयारी
hi_nuance: 'security posture' is a fixed phrase. Uncountable in this sense. Improve it, strengthen it, assess it.

examples.en: The audit improved our security posture.
examples.hi: Audit ने हमारी security posture सुधारी।

examples.en: Their posture is weak on the cloud side.
examples.hi: Cloud की ओर उनकी posture कमज़ोर है।

examples.en: We assess the posture every year.
examples.hi: हम हर साल posture का आकलन करते हैं।

examples.en: A strong posture reduces incident cost.
examples.hi: मज़बूत posture घटना की लागत घटाती है।

examples.en: Patching quickly strengthens your posture.
examples.hi: तेज़ी से patch करना आपकी posture मज़बूत करता है।

common_mistake.wrong: Our security postures are weak.
common_mistake.right: Our security posture is weak.
common_mistake.why: In this sense 'posture' is uncountable; keep it singular.

cloze.sentence: Regular patching and monitoring strengthen the security ____.

en_def: to isolate a suspicious file or system so it cannot cause harm
hi_def: किसी संदिग्ध file या सिस्टम को अलग करना ताकि वह नुक़सान न कर सके
hi_nuance: Both verb and noun. Antivirus tools 'quarantine' malware. Similar to 'isolate' but often automatic.

examples.en: The antivirus quarantined the malicious file.
examples.hi: Antivirus ने malicious file को quarantine किया।

examples.en: We quarantined the infected laptop.
examples.hi: हमने infected laptop को quarantine किया।

examples.en: Quarantine the host before analysis.
examples.hi: विश्लेषण से पहले host को quarantine करें।

examples.en: The file sits in quarantine until reviewed.
examples.hi: File समीक्षा तक quarantine में रहती है।

examples.en: Quarantining stops the malware from spreading.
examples.hi: Quarantine करना malware को फैलने से रोकता है।

common_mistake.wrong: We did quarantine to the infected machine.
common_mistake.right: We quarantined the infected machine.
common_mistake.why: Use the verb 'quarantined'.

cloze.sentence: When malware is detected, the tool will ____ the file automatically.

en_def: to separate a system from others to stop a problem spreading
hi_def: किसी सिस्टम को दूसरों से अलग करना ताकि समस्या न फैले
hi_nuance: During incidents, 'isolate the host' means cut its network access. Broader than 'quarantine'.

examples.en: Isolate the compromised server immediately.
examples.hi: Compromised server को तुरंत isolate करें।

examples.en: We isolated the subnet to contain the breach.
examples.hi: Breach रोकने के लिए हमने subnet isolate किया।

examples.en: Isolating the host cut the attacker off.
examples.hi: Host isolate करने से हमलावर कट गया।

examples.en: Network isolation limits lateral movement.
examples.hi: Network isolation lateral movement सीमित करता है।

examples.en: Isolate first, then investigate.
examples.hi: पहले isolate करें, फिर जाँच करें।

common_mistake.wrong: Please isolate out the affected server.
common_mistake.right: Please isolate the affected server.
common_mistake.why: 'isolate' is transitive; do not add 'out'.

cloze.sentence: During an incident, first ____ the machine from the network.

en_def: to stop an incident from spreading further
hi_def: किसी घटना को और फैलने से रोकना
hi_nuance: 'containment' is a phase of incident response. Different from 'eradication' (removing the threat).

examples.en: We contained the breach within an hour.
examples.hi: हमने एक घंटे में breach contain किया।

examples.en: Containment prevented data loss.
examples.hi: Containment ने data loss रोका।

examples.en: Isolating the host helped contain the incident.
examples.hi: Host isolate करने से incident contain करने में मदद मिली।

examples.en: Contain first, then eradicate the malware.
examples.hi: पहले contain करें, फिर malware eradicate करें।

examples.en: The team failed to contain the spread.
examples.hi: Team फैलाव को contain करने में विफल रही।

common_mistake.wrong: We tried to contain the incident from spreading more.
common_mistake.right: We tried to contain the incident.
common_mistake.why: 'contain' already means stop it spreading; the extra phrase is redundant.

cloze.sentence: The first goal of incident response is to ____ the damage.

en_def: a successful attack in which data or systems are compromised
hi_def: एक सफल हमला जिसमें data या systems compromised हो जाते हैं
hi_nuance: Stronger than 'leak'. 'data breach' is countable. As a verb: 'they breached the network'.

examples.en: The breach exposed millions of records.
examples.hi: इस breach ने लाखों records expose किए।

examples.en: We disclosed the breach to affected users.
examples.hi: हमने प्रभावित users को breach के बारे में बताया।

examples.en: The attacker breached the network via VPN.
examples.hi: हमलावर ने VPN के ज़रिये network breach किया।

examples.en: A breach can cost far more than prevention.
examples.hi: एक breach रोकथाम से कहीं ज़्यादा महँगा पड़ सकता है।

examples.en: The breach was traced to a phishing email.
examples.hi: Breach का सूत्र एक phishing email तक पहुँचा।

common_mistake.wrong: There was a breach happened in the company.
common_mistake.right: A breach occurred at the company.
common_mistake.why: 'was a breach happened' is a double verb; say 'A breach occurred'.

cloze.sentence: The company reported a data ____ affecting all customers.

en_def: any event that harms or threatens security
hi_def: कोई भी घटना जो सुरक्षा को नुक़सान पहुँचाए या ख़तरे में डाले
hi_nuance: 'incident response' (IR) is the plan to handle it. Not every alert is an incident; triage decides.

examples.en: We opened a security incident at 2 a.m.
examples.hi: हमने रात 2 बजे एक security incident खोला।

examples.en: The incident response plan worked well.
examples.hi: Incident response plan अच्छा काम किया।

examples.en: Log the incident with a clear timeline.
examples.hi: Incident को एक साफ़ timeline के साथ log करें।

examples.en: This alert was not a real incident.
examples.hi: यह alert कोई असली incident नहीं था।

examples.en: The incident affected only one region.
examples.hi: यह incident सिर्फ़ एक region को प्रभावित हुआ।

common_mistake.wrong: One incident is happened yesterday.
common_mistake.right: An incident occurred yesterday.
common_mistake.why: Use 'An incident occurred'; 'is happened' is incorrect.

cloze.sentence: The team followed the ____ response plan step by step.

en_def: the analysis of systems and data to understand how an attack happened
hi_def: यह समझने के लिए systems और data का विश्लेषण कि हमला कैसे हुआ
hi_nuance: Treated as singular ('forensics is'). 'digital forensics' collects evidence carefully to preserve it.

examples.en: Forensics revealed the initial entry point.
examples.hi: Forensics ने प्रारंभिक entry point उजागर किया।

examples.en: Digital forensics preserved the disk image.
examples.hi: Digital forensics ने disk image सुरक्षित रखी।

examples.en: Forensics is slow but thorough.
examples.hi: Forensics धीमी पर पूरी होती है।

examples.en: We called in a forensics team.
examples.hi: हमने एक forensics team बुलाई।

examples.en: Good logging makes forensics possible.
examples.hi: अच्छी logging forensics को संभव बनाती है।

common_mistake.wrong: The forensics are still going on.
common_mistake.right: Forensics is still ongoing.
common_mistake.why: 'forensics' takes a singular verb here.

cloze.sentence: After the breach, ____ traced how the attacker got in.

en_def: a sign that an attack may have happened, such as a suspicious IP or file hash
hi_def: एक संकेत कि हमला हुआ हो सकता है, जैसे कोई संदिग्ध IP या file hash
hi_nuance: 'indicator of compromise' (IOC) is the fixed phrase. Shared between teams to detect the same threat.

examples.en: We shared the indicators of compromise.
examples.hi: हमने indicators of compromise साझा किए।

examples.en: The malicious hash is a strong indicator.
examples.hi: Malicious hash एक मज़बूत indicator है।

examples.en: Block the indicators across all firewalls.
examples.hi: सभी firewalls पर indicators block करें।

examples.en: One weak indicator is not proof.
examples.hi: एक कमज़ोर indicator प्रमाण नहीं है।

examples.en: Threat feeds provide fresh indicators.
examples.hi: Threat feeds ताज़ा indicators देते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: This IP is a indicator of compromise.
common_mistake.right: This IP is an indicator of compromise.
common_mistake.why: Use 'an' before a vowel sound ('an indicator').

cloze.sentence: A known-bad file hash is a useful ____ of compromise.

en_def: something that differs from normal and may signal a problem
hi_def: कोई चीज़ जो सामान्य से अलग हो और किसी समस्या का संकेत दे सकती है
hi_nuance: 'anomaly detection' spots unusual behaviour. Plural: anomalies. Not every anomaly is an attack.

examples.en: The login spike was a clear anomaly.
examples.hi: Login में अचानक उछाल एक स्पष्ट anomaly थी।

examples.en: Anomaly detection flagged the unusual traffic.
examples.hi: Anomaly detection ने असामान्य traffic को flag किया।

examples.en: We investigate every anomaly.
examples.hi: हम हर anomaly की जाँच करते हैं।

examples.en: The anomaly turned out to be a batch job.
examples.hi: यह anomaly आख़िर में एक batch job निकली।

examples.en: Baselines help us spot anomalies.
examples.hi: Baselines हमें anomalies पहचानने में मदद करती हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: There are many anomaly in the logs.
common_mistake.right: There are many anomalies in the logs.
common_mistake.why: Plural of 'anomaly' is 'anomalies'.

cloze.sentence: A sudden burst of failed logins is an ____ worth checking.

en_def: a list of items that are explicitly permitted; everything else is blocked
hi_def: उन चीज़ों की सूची जिन्हें साफ़ तौर पर अनुमति है; बाक़ी सब blocked
hi_nuance: Modern term replacing 'whitelist'. Allowlisting is safer than blocklisting for input validation.

examples.en: Use an allowlist of valid file types.
examples.hi: मान्य file types की एक allowlist इस्तेमाल करें।

examples.en: The allowlist blocks every unknown host.
examples.hi: Allowlist हर अनजान host को block करती है।

examples.en: Allowlisting is safer than blocklisting.
examples.hi: Allowlisting, blocklisting से सुरक्षित है।

examples.en: Add the CI server to the allowlist.
examples.hi: CI server को allowlist में जोड़ें।

examples.en: Only allowlisted domains can call the API.
examples.hi: सिर्फ़ allowlisted domains ही API को call कर सकते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: Add this IP in the allow list.
common_mistake.right: Add this IP to the allowlist.
common_mistake.why: One word 'allowlist'; use 'to', not 'in'.

cloze.sentence: Instead of blocking bad values, accept only those on an ____.

en_def: a list of items that are explicitly forbidden; everything else is allowed
hi_def: उन चीज़ों की सूची जो साफ़ तौर पर मना हैं; बाक़ी सब की अनुमति है
hi_nuance: Modern term replacing 'blacklist'. Blocklists miss new bad values, so allowlists are usually preferred.

examples.en: The blocklist filters known bad IPs.
examples.hi: Blocklist ज्ञात ख़राब IPs को filter करती है।

examples.en: A blocklist can be bypassed with new payloads.
examples.hi: Blocklist को नए payloads से bypass किया जा सकता है।

examples.en: We added the attacker's IP to the blocklist.
examples.hi: हमने हमलावर की IP को blocklist में जोड़ा।

examples.en: Blocklisting alone is not enough.
examples.hi: अकेली blocklisting काफ़ी नहीं है।

examples.en: The blocklist grows every week.
examples.hi: Blocklist हर हफ़्ते बढ़ती है।

common_mistake.wrong: The filter is using blocklist approach only.
common_mistake.right: The filter uses a blocklist approach only.
common_mistake.why: Use simple present 'uses' and the article 'a'.

cloze.sentence: Filtering only known-bad words with a ____ misses new attacks.

en_def: to make code or data hard to read or understand
hi_def: code या data को पढ़ने या समझने में कठिन बनाना
hi_nuance: Obfuscation is not security; it only slows analysis. Attackers obfuscate payloads to evade filters.

examples.en: The malware obfuscates its strings.
examples.hi: Malware अपनी strings को obfuscate करता है।

examples.en: Obfuscated JavaScript hid the real payload.
examples.hi: Obfuscated JavaScript ने असली payload छिपाया।

examples.en: Do not rely on obfuscation for secrets.
examples.hi: Secrets के लिए obfuscation पर भरोसा न करें।

examples.en: We deobfuscated the script to read it.
examples.hi: हमने script को deobfuscate करके पढ़ा।

examples.en: Obfuscating the API key does not protect it.
examples.hi: API key को obfuscate करना उसकी रक्षा नहीं करता।

common_mistake.wrong: The key is obfuscated so it is safe.
common_mistake.right: The key is only obfuscated, so it is not actually safe.
common_mistake.why: Obfuscation is reversible; do not equate it with real protection.

cloze.sentence: The attacker used encoding to ____ the malicious script.

en_def: a fixed-length fingerprint of data produced by a one-way function
hi_def: किसी data का एक निश्चित-लंबाई वाला fingerprint, जो one-way function से बनता है
hi_nuance: Hashing is one-way (cannot be reversed), unlike encoding or encryption. Passwords should be salted and hashed.

examples.en: Store a salted hash, never the raw password.
examples.hi: Raw password नहीं, salted hash store करें।

examples.en: The file hash confirms it was not modified.
examples.hi: File hash पुष्टि करता है कि इसे बदला नहीं गया।

examples.en: A weak hash like MD5 is broken.
examples.hi: MD5 जैसा कमज़ोर hash टूटा हुआ है।

examples.en: Two files with the same hash are identical.
examples.hi: एक ही hash वाली दो files समान होती हैं।

examples.en: We compared the download against its hash.
examples.hi: हमने download की उसके hash से तुलना की।

common_mistake.wrong: The password hash can be decrypted easily.
common_mistake.right: The password hash cannot be decrypted; it can only be cracked by guessing.
common_mistake.why: Hashing is one-way; you 'crack' by guessing, you do not 'decrypt' it.

cloze.sentence: Passwords must be stored as a salted ____, not in plain text.

en_def: a clear way to state what you managed to achieve during testing
hi_def: यह बताने का साफ़ तरीक़ा कि testing के दौरान आप क्या कर पाए
hi_nuance: Preferred report phrasing over 'I could able to' (a common Indian-English error). Follow with a base verb.

examples.en: I was able to read another user's private messages.
examples.hi: मैं दूसरे user के निजी messages पढ़ने में सफल रहा।

examples.en: I was able to bypass the login completely.
examples.hi: मैं login को पूरी तरह bypass करने में सफल रहा।

examples.en: Using this token, I was able to access the admin panel.
examples.hi: इस token से मैं admin panel तक पहुँचने में सफल रहा।

examples.en: I was able to reproduce the issue three times.
examples.hi: मैं इस issue को तीन बार reproduce करने में सफल रहा।

examples.en: I was not able to escalate beyond a normal user.
examples.hi: मैं एक normal user से आगे escalate नहीं कर पाया।

common_mistake.wrong: I could able to access the admin panel.
common_mistake.right: I was able to access the admin panel.
common_mistake.why: 'could able to' is a double modal; use 'was able to' + base verb.

cloze.sentence: By changing the ID, ____ view invoices belonging to other customers.

en_def: a standard way to explain the impact of a vulnerability
hi_def: किसी vulnerability का impact समझाने का एक मानक तरीक़ा
hi_nuance: Impact sentences use this. Follow with a base verb: 'to read', 'to modify'. Note the article 'an attacker'.

examples.en: This allows an attacker to read arbitrary files.
examples.hi: यह एक हमलावर को arbitrary files पढ़ने देता है।

examples.en: This allows an attacker to take over any account.
examples.hi: यह एक हमलावर को किसी भी account पर क़ब्ज़ा करने देता है।

examples.en: This allows an attacker to run code on the server.
examples.hi: यह एक हमलावर को server पर code चलाने देता है।

examples.en: In short, this allows an attacker to bypass payment.
examples.hi: संक्षेप में, यह एक हमलावर को payment bypass करने देता है।

examples.en: This allows an attacker to enumerate all users.
examples.hi: यह एक हमलावर को सभी users enumerate करने देता है।

collocations: this allows an attacker to read

common_mistake.wrong: This allows attacker to reads the data.
common_mistake.right: This allows an attacker to read the data.
common_mistake.why: Add the article 'an'; after 'to' use the base verb 'read'.

cloze.sentence: The missing check means ____ modify another user's profile.

en_def: a phrase pointing the reader to a proof or example that follows
hi_def: एक वाक्यांश जो पाठक को नीचे दिए प्रमाण या उदाहरण की ओर ले जाता है
hi_nuance: Use before screenshots or steps. Cleaner than 'as I show in below screenshot' (Indian-English word order).

examples.en: The token can be reused, as demonstrated below.
examples.hi: Token दोबारा इस्तेमाल हो सकता है, जैसा नीचे दिखाया गया है।

examples.en: As demonstrated below, the filter is easily bypassed.
examples.hi: जैसा नीचे दिखाया गया है, filter आसानी से bypass हो जाता है।

examples.en: The response leaks the key, as demonstrated below.
examples.hi: Response key leak करता है, जैसा नीचे दिखाया गया है।

examples.en: As demonstrated below, no authentication is required.
examples.hi: जैसा नीचे दिखाया गया है, किसी authentication की ज़रूरत नहीं है।

examples.en: The full request is shown, as demonstrated below.
examples.hi: पूरी request दिखाई गई है, जैसा नीचे दिखाया गया है।

common_mistake.wrong: As I show in below screenshot the bug works.
common_mistake.right: The bug works, as demonstrated below.
common_mistake.why: Fix word order; 'below screenshot' should be 'the screenshot below' or 'as demonstrated below'.

cloze.sentence: The server accepts the forged cookie, ____.

en_def: a standard heading that introduces reproduction instructions
hi_def: एक मानक heading जो reproduce करने के निर्देश शुरू करती है
hi_nuance: Use before a numbered list. Better than 'steps to reproduce the same' where 'the same' is an Indianism.

examples.en: The following steps reproduce the vulnerability.
examples.hi: नीचे दिए steps इस vulnerability को reproduce करते हैं।

examples.en: The following steps reproduce the crash reliably.
examples.hi: नीचे दिए steps crash को भरोसेमंद तरीक़े से reproduce करते हैं।

examples.en: The following steps reproduce the issue on a fresh account.
examples.hi: नीचे दिए steps issue को एक नए account पर reproduce करते हैं।

examples.en: The following steps reproduce the bypass end to end.
examples.hi: नीचे दिए steps bypass को शुरू से अंत तक reproduce करते हैं।

examples.en: The following steps reproduce the data leak.
examples.hi: नीचे दिए steps data leak को reproduce करते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: Below steps to reproduce the same bug.
common_mistake.right: The following steps reproduce the bug.
common_mistake.why: Use 'The following steps'; drop the Indianism 'the same'.

cloze.sentence: ____ the account-takeover issue on any test user.

en_def: a formal way to introduce a remediation recommendation
hi_def: किसी remediation सिफ़ारिश को शुरू करने का औपचारिक तरीक़ा
hi_nuance: Followed by a base verb (subjunctive): 'it is recommended that the team validate...'. Common in report fix sections.

examples.en: It is recommended that the input be validated server-side.
examples.hi: यह सिफ़ारिश की जाती है कि input server-side पर validate किया जाए।

examples.en: It is recommended that all tokens expire after use.
examples.hi: यह सिफ़ारिश की जाती है कि सभी tokens उपयोग के बाद expire हों।

examples.en: It is recommended that the endpoint require authentication.
examples.hi: यह सिफ़ारिश की जाती है कि endpoint authentication माँगे।

examples.en: It is recommended that the team apply least privilege.
examples.hi: यह सिफ़ारिश की जाती है कि team least privilege लागू करे।

examples.en: It is recommended that credentials be rotated immediately.
examples.hi: यह सिफ़ारिश की जाती है कि credentials तुरंत rotate किए जाएँ।

common_mistake.wrong: It is recommended to the team that they should validating input.
common_mistake.right: It is recommended that the team validate input.
common_mistake.why: Subjunctive base verb 'validate'; drop 'should' and '-ing'.

cloze.sentence: ____ the server reject requests without a valid CSRF token.

en_def: a standard phrase to introduce a file included with a message
hi_def: किसी message के साथ भेजी गई file का परिचय देने का मानक वाक्यांश
hi_nuance: Neutral-to-formal. A more modern alternative is 'I've attached'. Avoid 'PFA' in external emails.

examples.en: Please find attached the full report.
examples.hi: पूरी report संलग्न है।

examples.en: Please find attached a video of the exploit.
examples.hi: Exploit का एक video संलग्न है।

examples.en: Please find attached the logs you requested.
examples.hi: आपकी माँगी हुई logs संलग्न हैं।

examples.en: Please find attached the updated proof of concept.
examples.hi: अद्यतन proof of concept संलग्न है।

examples.en: Please find attached my findings from the retest.
examples.hi: Retest से मेरी findings संलग्न हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: PFA the report for your reference.
common_mistake.right: Please find attached the report for your reference.
common_mistake.why: Avoid the abbreviation 'PFA' in professional external emails; write it out.

cloze.sentence: ____ the detailed reproduction steps and screenshots.

en_def: a phrase meaning the information is provided so the reader can consult it later
hi_def: एक वाक्यांश जिसका अर्थ है कि जानकारी इसलिए दी गई है ताकि पाठक बाद में देख सके
hi_nuance: Fine in professional English. Do not overuse it in every sentence, which is a common Indian-email habit.

examples.en: I've included the request headers for your reference.
examples.hi: आपके संदर्भ के लिए मैंने request headers शामिल किए हैं।

examples.en: For your reference, the CVE is listed below.
examples.hi: आपके संदर्भ के लिए, CVE नीचे दी गई है।

examples.en: The policy link is added for your reference.
examples.hi: आपके संदर्भ के लिए policy link जोड़ा गया है।

examples.en: For your reference, here is the original ticket.
examples.hi: आपके संदर्भ के लिए, यह रहा मूल ticket।

examples.en: I'm sharing the timeline for your reference.
examples.hi: आपके संदर्भ के लिए मैं timeline साझा कर रहा हूँ।

common_mistake.wrong: For your kind reference please check the below.
common_mistake.right: For your reference, please see below.
common_mistake.why: Drop 'kind'; use 'see below', not 'check the below'.

cloze.sentence: I've attached the raw HTTP logs ____.

en_def: an over-formal phrase asking the reader to notice something; sounds dated to native readers
hi_def: एक अति-औपचारिक वाक्यांश जो पाठक से कुछ ध्यान देने को कहता है; native पाठकों को पुराना लगता है
hi_nuance: This is an Indianism to unlearn. Prefer 'Please note' or just state the fact directly.

examples.en: Awkward: Kindly note the token does not expire.
examples.hi: अटपटा: Kindly note कि token expire नहीं होता।

examples.en: Natural: Please note that the token does not expire.
examples.hi: स्वाभाविक: कृपया ध्यान दें कि token expire नहीं होता।

examples.en: Better still: Note that the token never expires.
examples.hi: और बेहतर: ध्यान दें कि token कभी expire नहीं होता।

examples.en: Avoid starting every line with 'Kindly note'.
examples.hi: हर line को 'Kindly note' से शुरू करने से बचें।

examples.en: Please note the endpoint is public.
examples.hi: कृपया ध्यान दें कि endpoint public है।

common_mistake.wrong: Kindly note that kindly do the needful.
common_mistake.right: Please note this and take the necessary action.
common_mistake.why: 'Kindly' and 'do the needful' are Indianisms; use plain, direct English.

cloze.sentence: Instead of 'Kindly note', write 'Please ____' or state the fact plainly.

en_def: a polite formal way to ask someone to act as soon as they reasonably can
hi_def: किसी से जल्द से जल्द, उनकी सुविधा अनुसार, कार्रवाई करने को कहने का विनम्र औपचारिक तरीक़ा
hi_nuance: Correct and polite. Prefer this to the Indianism 'at the earliest', which sounds abrupt to native readers.

examples.en: Please review the report at your earliest convenience.
examples.hi: कृपया अपनी सुविधानुसार जल्द ही report की समीक्षा करें।

examples.en: Could you patch this at your earliest convenience?
examples.hi: क्या आप इसे जल्द से जल्द patch कर सकते हैं?

examples.en: Kindly confirm receipt at your earliest convenience.
examples.hi: कृपया जल्द ही प्राप्ति की पुष्टि करें।

examples.en: I'd appreciate a fix at your earliest convenience.
examples.hi: जल्द से जल्द एक fix मिले तो मैं आभारी रहूँगा।

examples.en: Please respond at your earliest convenience.
examples.hi: कृपया जल्द से जल्द जवाब दें।

common_mistake.wrong: Please do it at the earliest.
common_mistake.right: Please do it at your earliest convenience.
common_mistake.why: 'at the earliest' is an Indianism; the full phrase is 'at your earliest convenience' (or 'as soon as possible').

cloze.sentence: Please review and confirm the fix ____.

en_def: a polite way to make a request
hi_def: विनम्रता से अनुरोध करने का एक तरीक़ा
hi_nuance: Followed by a past-tense clause: 'if you could...'. Softer and more natural than 'kindly do the needful'.

examples.en: I'd appreciate it if you could confirm the severity.
examples.hi: अगर आप severity की पुष्टि कर सकें तो मैं आभारी रहूँगा।

examples.en: I'd appreciate it if this were prioritised.
examples.hi: अगर इसे प्राथमिकता मिले तो मैं आभारी रहूँगा।

examples.en: I'd appreciate it if you kept me updated.
examples.hi: अगर आप मुझे updated रखें तो मैं आभारी रहूँगा।

examples.en: I'd appreciate it if you could share a timeline.
examples.hi: अगर आप एक timeline साझा कर सकें तो मैं आभारी रहूँगा।

examples.en: I'd appreciate it if the retest happened this week.
examples.hi: अगर retest इसी हफ़्ते हो जाए तो मैं आभारी रहूँगा।

common_mistake.wrong: I will appreciate if you do the needful.
common_mistake.right: I'd appreciate it if you could take the necessary action.
common_mistake.why: Use 'I'd appreciate it if you could...'; avoid 'do the needful'.

cloze.sentence: ____ you could confirm whether this is in scope.

en_def: a polite way to ask a yes/no question in professional writing
hi_def: पेशेवर लेखन में विनम्रता से एक हाँ/ना प्रश्न पूछने का तरीक़ा
hi_nuance: Use 'whether', not 'that', for yes/no questions. Note the embedded word order: 'whether this is', not 'whether is this'.

examples.en: Could you confirm whether this domain is in scope?
examples.hi: क्या आप पुष्टि कर सकते हैं कि यह domain in scope है?

examples.en: Could you confirm whether the fix is deployed?
examples.hi: क्या आप पुष्टि कर सकते हैं कि fix deploy हो चुका है?

examples.en: Could you confirm whether you received my report?
examples.hi: क्या आप पुष्टि कर सकते हैं कि आपको मेरी report मिली?

examples.en: Could you confirm whether a bounty applies here?
examples.hi: क्या आप पुष्टि कर सकते हैं कि यहाँ bounty लागू होती है?

examples.en: Could you confirm whether the account was affected?
examples.hi: क्या आप पुष्टि कर सकते हैं कि account प्रभावित हुआ था?

common_mistake.wrong: Could you confirm whether is this in scope?
common_mistake.right: Could you confirm whether this is in scope?
common_mistake.why: Embedded question keeps statement word order: 'whether this is', not 'whether is this'.

cloze.sentence: ____ the staging server is included in the test scope?

en_def: a phrase used to make a point clearer or check understanding
hi_def: किसी बात को और स्पष्ट करने या समझ जाँचने के लिए इस्तेमाल किया जाने वाला वाक्यांश
hi_nuance: Very natural in professional chat and email. Softer than 'For your clarification'.

examples.en: Just to clarify, the bug affects all users, not just admins.
examples.hi: बस स्पष्ट कर दूँ, यह bug सभी users को प्रभावित करता है, सिर्फ़ admins को नहीं।

examples.en: Just to clarify, do you need a video PoC?
examples.hi: बस स्पष्ट कर दूँ, क्या आपको video PoC चाहिए?

examples.en: Just to clarify, I tested only the staging site.
examples.hi: बस स्पष्ट कर दूँ, मैंने सिर्फ़ staging site test की।

examples.en: Just to clarify, this is a separate issue.
examples.hi: बस स्पष्ट कर दूँ, यह एक अलग issue है।

examples.en: Just to clarify, no data was actually modified.
examples.hi: बस स्पष्ट कर दूँ, असल में कोई data नहीं बदला गया।

common_mistake.wrong: For your clarification only, the bug is critical.
common_mistake.right: Just to clarify, the bug is critical.
common_mistake.why: 'For your clarification only' is stiff; 'Just to clarify' is natural.

cloze.sentence: ____, the exploit needs no login at all.

en_def: a phrase thanking someone for responding or fixing something quickly
hi_def: किसी को जल्दी जवाब देने या ठीक करने के लिए धन्यवाद देने का वाक्यांश
hi_nuance: 'turnaround' here means the time taken to respond. Warm and professional; good for building rapport with triagers.

examples.en: Thanks for the quick turnaround on the fix.
examples.hi: Fix पर इतनी जल्दी काम करने के लिए धन्यवाद।

examples.en: Thanks for the quick turnaround; the retest passed.
examples.hi: जल्दी जवाब देने के लिए धन्यवाद; retest पास हो गया।

examples.en: Thanks for the quick turnaround on triage.
examples.hi: Triage पर जल्दी काम करने के लिए धन्यवाद।

examples.en: Really appreciate the quick turnaround.
examples.hi: इतनी तेज़ प्रतिक्रिया की सचमुच सराहना करता हूँ।

examples.en: Thanks for the quick turnaround over the weekend.
examples.hi: Weekend में इतनी जल्दी करने के लिए धन्यवाद।

common_mistake.wrong: Thanks for the fast revert.
common_mistake.right: Thanks for the quick turnaround.
common_mistake.why: 'revert' meaning 'reply' is an Indianism; use 'response' or 'turnaround'.

cloze.sentence: The patch landed the same day, so I wrote: ____.

en_def: a friendly offer to share further information if needed
hi_def: ज़रूरत पड़ने पर और जानकारी देने की एक मित्रवत पेशकश
hi_nuance: Natural closing line for a report or email. More modern than 'Please revert for any clarifications'.

examples.en: Happy to provide more details if needed.
examples.hi: ज़रूरत हो तो और जानकारी देने में मुझे ख़ुशी होगी।

examples.en: Happy to provide more details or a live demo.
examples.hi: और जानकारी या एक live demo देने में ख़ुशी होगी।

examples.en: Happy to provide more details on the exploit chain.
examples.hi: Exploit chain पर और जानकारी देने में ख़ुशी होगी।

examples.en: Happy to provide more details during a call.
examples.hi: किसी call पर और जानकारी देने में ख़ुशी होगी।

examples.en: Let me know; happy to provide more details.
examples.hi: मुझे बताइए; और जानकारी देने में ख़ुशी होगी।

synonyms: let me know if you need more

common_mistake.wrong: Please revert back for any clarifications.
common_mistake.right: Happy to provide more details if you have any questions.
common_mistake.why: 'revert back' is redundant and an Indianism; offer help naturally.

cloze.sentence: That covers the finding. ____ if you need anything else.

en_def: a phrase introducing a message that continues an earlier one
hi_def: एक वाक्यांश जो किसी पिछली बात को आगे बढ़ाने वाले संदेश का परिचय देता है
hi_nuance: Noun 'follow-up' is hyphenated; verb is 'follow up'. Good for chasing a report politely.

examples.en: As a follow-up, I retested and the bug is fixed.
examples.hi: आगे की बात के रूप में, मैंने retest किया और bug ठीक है।

examples.en: As a follow-up to my last email, here is the PoC.
examples.hi: मेरी पिछली email के आगे, यह रहा PoC।

examples.en: As a follow-up, could you confirm the reward?
examples.hi: आगे की बात के रूप में, क्या आप reward की पुष्टि कर सकते हैं?

examples.en: As a follow-up, I found a related issue.
examples.hi: आगे की बात के रूप में, मुझे एक संबंधित issue मिला।

examples.en: I'll follow up next week if there's no reply.
examples.hi: जवाब न आया तो मैं अगले हफ़्ते follow up करूँगा।

common_mistake.wrong: As a followup, kindly do the needful on my report.
common_mistake.right: As a follow-up, could you update me on my report?
common_mistake.why: Hyphenate 'follow-up'; replace 'do the needful' with a clear request.

cloze.sentence: ____ to my report from Monday, the issue still reproduces.

en_def: a phrase introducing a short restatement of the main points
hi_def: मुख्य बिंदुओं को संक्षेप में दोहराने वाला वाक्यांश
hi_nuance: American spelling 'to summarize'. Use at the end of a long report. Follow with the key impact and fix.

examples.en: To summarise, an unauthenticated user can take over any account.
examples.hi: संक्षेप में, एक unauthenticated user किसी भी account पर क़ब्ज़ा कर सकता है।

examples.en: To summarise, the root cause is missing authorization.
examples.hi: संक्षेप में, मूल कारण authorization का न होना है।

examples.en: To summarise, three low bugs chain into a critical one.
examples.hi: संक्षेप में, तीन low bugs मिलकर एक critical बन जाते हैं।

examples.en: To summarise, please validate input on the server.
examples.hi: संक्षेप में, कृपया server पर input validate करें।

examples.en: To summarise, the fix is one line of code.
examples.hi: संक्षेप में, fix code की एक line है।

common_mistake.wrong: To summarise the whole thing in short briefly...
common_mistake.right: To summarise, ...
common_mistake.why: 'in short briefly' is redundant with 'summarise'; keep it to one phrase.

cloze.sentence: ____, the endpoint leaks tokens and must require authentication.

en_def: a phrase meaning during the time until something else happens
hi_def: एक वाक्यांश जिसका अर्थ है किसी और घटना के होने तक के समय में
hi_nuance: Use to suggest a temporary action before a permanent fix. Different from 'meanwhile' only in style.

examples.en: In the meantime, please disable the endpoint.
examples.hi: इस बीच, कृपया endpoint बंद कर दें।

examples.en: A patch is coming; in the meantime, use the workaround.
examples.hi: Patch आ रहा है; इस बीच, workaround इस्तेमाल करें।

examples.en: In the meantime, I'll keep testing related routes.
examples.hi: इस बीच, मैं संबंधित routes test करता रहूँगा।

examples.en: In the meantime, rotate the exposed keys.
examples.hi: इस बीच, exposed keys rotate कर दें।

examples.en: In the meantime, let me know if you need logs.
examples.hi: इस बीच, logs चाहिए तो बताइए।

common_mistake.wrong: In the mean time do the temporary fix.
common_mistake.right: In the meantime, apply the temporary fix.
common_mistake.why: 'meantime' is one word here; use 'apply', not 'do'.

cloze.sentence: The full fix ships next sprint; ____, block the header.

en_def: a phrase meaning from now on, in the future
hi_def: एक वाक्यांश जिसका अर्थ है अब से, भविष्य में
hi_nuance: Common in professional English for future policy. Do not confuse with the Indianism 'kindly revert going forward'.

examples.en: Going forward, all input will be validated server-side.
examples.hi: आगे से, सारा input server-side पर validate होगा।

examples.en: Going forward, we'll rotate keys every 90 days.
examples.hi: आगे से, हम हर 90 दिन में keys rotate करेंगे।

examples.en: Going forward, please tag security tickets clearly.
examples.hi: आगे से, कृपया security tickets साफ़ tag करें।

examples.en: Going forward, the endpoint will require auth.
examples.hi: आगे से, endpoint auth माँगेगा।

examples.en: Going forward, we'll add a regression test.
examples.hi: आगे से, हम एक regression test जोड़ेंगे।

common_mistake.wrong: Going forward kindly revert on time.
common_mistake.right: Going forward, please reply on time.
common_mistake.why: 'revert' meaning 'reply' is an Indianism; drop 'kindly' too.

cloze.sentence: ____, every new endpoint must enforce authentication.

en_def: a phrase offering to explain something step by step
hi_def: किसी चीज़ को step by step समझाने की पेशकश करने वाला वाक्यांश
hi_nuance: 'walk someone through' is a friendly idiom for guiding them. Great before reproduction steps on a call.

examples.en: Let me walk you through the exploit step by step.
examples.hi: मैं आपको exploit step by step समझाता हूँ।

examples.en: Let me walk you through how the token leaks.
examples.hi: मैं आपको समझाता हूँ कि token कैसे leak होता है।

examples.en: On the call, let me walk you through the request.
examples.hi: Call पर, मैं आपको request समझाता हूँ।

examples.en: Let me walk you through the fix I'm suggesting.
examples.hi: मैं आपको वह fix समझाता हूँ जो मैं सुझा रहा हूँ।

examples.en: Let me walk you through the impact first.
examples.hi: पहले मैं आपको impact समझाता हूँ।

common_mistake.wrong: Let me explain you the steps.
common_mistake.right: Let me walk you through the steps.
common_mistake.why: 'explain you' is wrong; use 'explain to you' or 'walk you through'.

cloze.sentence: ____ the reproduction, then you can try it yourself.

en_def: an Indian-English phrase meaning 'please take the necessary action'; sounds odd to native readers
hi_def: एक भारतीय-अंग्रेज़ी वाक्यांश जिसका अर्थ है 'कृपया ज़रूरी कार्रवाई करें'; native पाठकों को अटपटा लगता है
hi_nuance: This is an Indianism to unlearn. State exactly what you want done instead of 'do the needful'.

examples.en: Awkward: Please do the needful and fix it.
examples.hi: अटपटा: Please do the needful और इसे ठीक करें।

examples.en: Natural: Please review and deploy the fix.
examples.hi: स्वाभाविक: कृपया fix की समीक्षा करें और deploy करें।

examples.en: Natural: Please take the necessary action.
examples.hi: स्वाभाविक: कृपया ज़रूरी कार्रवाई करें।

examples.en: Say what you need: Please patch the endpoint by Friday.
examples.hi: जो चाहिए वह कहें: कृपया Friday तक endpoint patch करें।

examples.en: Avoid 'do the needful' in reports to global teams.
examples.hi: Global teams को reports में 'do the needful' से बचें।

common_mistake.wrong: Please do the needful at the earliest.
common_mistake.right: Please deploy the fix as soon as possible.
common_mistake.why: Replace the vague Indianism with the specific action and 'as soon as possible'.

cloze.sentence: Instead of 'do the needful', write exactly what you want: 'please ____ the fix'.

en_def: an Indian-English phrase meaning 'reply to me'; 'revert' does not mean 'reply' in standard English
hi_def: एक भारतीय-अंग्रेज़ी वाक्यांश जिसका अर्थ है 'मुझे जवाब दें'; मानक अंग्रेज़ी में 'revert' का अर्थ 'जवाब देना' नहीं है
hi_nuance: Indianism to unlearn. In standard English 'revert' means 'go back to a previous state'. Use 'get back to me' or 'reply'.

examples.en: Awkward: Please revert back to me soon.
examples.hi: अटपटा: Please revert back to me जल्दी।

examples.en: Natural: Please get back to me soon.
examples.hi: स्वाभाविक: कृपया मुझे जल्द जवाब दें।

examples.en: Natural: Please reply when you can.
examples.hi: स्वाभाविक: कृपया जब सुविधा हो जवाब दें।

examples.en: 'Revert' actually means to roll back a change.
examples.hi: 'Revert' का असली अर्थ किसी change को वापस लौटाना है।

examples.en: We reverted the risky commit.
examples.hi: हमने जोखिम भरे commit को revert किया।

common_mistake.wrong: Kindly revert back to me on the same.
common_mistake.right: Please get back to me on this.
common_mistake.why: 'revert back' is doubly wrong (redundant + wrong meaning); 'on the same' is an Indianism for 'on this'.

cloze.sentence: Replace 'please revert back to me' with 'please ____ back to me'.

en_def: an Indian-English word meaning to move something to an earlier time; not used in standard English
hi_def: एक भारतीय-अंग्रेज़ी शब्द जिसका अर्थ है किसी चीज़ को पहले के समय पर लाना; मानक अंग्रेज़ी में इस्तेमाल नहीं होता
hi_nuance: Indianism to unlearn. The opposite of 'postpone' is 'bring forward' or 'move up', not 'prepone'.

examples.en: Awkward: Can we prepone the call?
examples.hi: अटपटा: क्या हम call को prepone कर सकते हैं?

examples.en: Natural: Can we bring the call forward?
examples.hi: स्वाभाविक: क्या हम call को पहले कर सकते हैं?

examples.en: Natural: Can we move the meeting up to Monday?
examples.hi: स्वाभाविक: क्या हम meeting को Monday तक पहले ला सकते हैं?

examples.en: They asked to bring the deadline forward.
examples.hi: उन्होंने deadline पहले लाने को कहा।

examples.en: We moved the review up by a day.
examples.hi: हमने review को एक दिन पहले कर दिया।

common_mistake.wrong: Please prepone the meeting to today.
common_mistake.right: Please bring the meeting forward to today.
common_mistake.why: 'prepone' is not standard English; use 'bring forward' or 'move up'.

cloze.sentence: Instead of 'prepone the call', say 'bring the call ____'.

en_def: a phrase referring back to something already talked about
hi_def: पहले से बातचीत की गई किसी बात का हवाला देने वाला वाक्यांश
hi_nuance: Acceptable but stiff and over-used in Indian offices. Natural alternatives: 'Following our chat' or 'As we discussed'.

examples.en: As we discussed, here is the updated report.
examples.hi: जैसा हमने चर्चा की, यह रही अद्यतन report।

examples.en: Following our call, I've attached the PoC.
examples.hi: हमारी call के बाद, मैंने PoC attach किया है।

examples.en: As per our discussion, the endpoint is out of scope.
examples.hi: हमारी चर्चा के अनुसार, endpoint out of scope है।

examples.en: As we agreed, I'll retest on Friday.
examples.hi: जैसा हम सहमत हुए, मैं Friday को retest करूँगा।

examples.en: Following up on our chat, the fix works.
examples.hi: हमारी बातचीत के आगे, fix काम करता है।

common_mistake.wrong: As per our discussion, please discuss about the fix again.
common_mistake.right: As we discussed, let's talk about the fix again.
common_mistake.why: 'discuss about' is wrong ('discuss' is transitive); 'as we discussed' is more natural.

cloze.sentence: ____, I'm sending the finalised severity ratings.

en_def: a formal phrase used to say what your message is about
hi_def: एक औपचारिक वाक्यांश जो बताता है कि आपका संदेश किस बारे में है
hi_nuance: Correct but formal. In email, 'Regarding' or 'About' is lighter. Follow with a noun, not a clause.

examples.en: With reference to ticket 512, the bug is fixed.
examples.hi: Ticket 512 के संदर्भ में, bug ठीक हो गया है।

examples.en: Regarding your last email, here is the log.
examples.hi: आपकी पिछली email के बारे में, यह रही log।

examples.en: With reference to the report, I have one question.
examples.hi: Report के संदर्भ में, मेरा एक सवाल है।

examples.en: About the retest, it passed cleanly.
examples.hi: Retest के बारे में, वह साफ़-साफ़ पास हुआ।

examples.en: With reference to our policy, DoS is out of scope.
examples.hi: हमारी policy के संदर्भ में, DoS out of scope है।

common_mistake.wrong: With reference to that you sent the report.
common_mistake.right: With reference to the report you sent, ...
common_mistake.why: Follow 'with reference to' with a noun phrase, not a bare clause.

cloze.sentence: ____ your query, the endpoint is indeed in scope.

en_def: a formal opening phrase that states the purpose of an email
hi_def: एक औपचारिक शुरुआती वाक्यांश जो email का उद्देश्य बताता है
hi_nuance: Classic formal email opener. Follow with an infinitive: 'I am writing to report...'. Fine for a first contact.

examples.en: I am writing to report a security vulnerability.
examples.hi: मैं एक security vulnerability की report करने के लिए लिख रहा हूँ।

examples.en: I am writing to follow up on my earlier report.
examples.hi: मैं अपनी पिछली report पर follow up करने के लिए लिख रहा हूँ।

examples.en: I am writing to request an update on the fix.
examples.hi: मैं fix पर एक update माँगने के लिए लिख रहा हूँ।

examples.en: I am writing to confirm the retest results.
examples.hi: मैं retest के परिणाम confirm करने के लिए लिख रहा हूँ।

examples.en: I am writing to disclose a flaw responsibly.
examples.hi: मैं एक flaw को responsibly disclose करने के लिए लिख रहा हूँ।

common_mistake.wrong: I am writing this mail for informing about a bug.
common_mistake.right: I am writing to report a bug.
common_mistake.why: Use 'to report'; 'for informing about' is wordy and non-idiomatic.

cloze.sentence: ____ report a critical flaw in your login system.

en_def: a formal closing phrase inviting the reader to ask for clarification
hi_def: एक औपचारिक समापन वाक्यांश जो पाठक को कुछ पूछने के लिए आमंत्रित करता है
hi_nuance: Formal inversion of 'if you have any questions'. Good for reports to enterprise teams.

examples.en: Should you have any questions, please let me know.
examples.hi: यदि आपके कोई प्रश्न हों, तो कृपया मुझे बताएँ।

examples.en: Should you have any questions, I'm happy to help.
examples.hi: यदि आपके कोई प्रश्न हों, तो मुझे मदद करने में ख़ुशी होगी।

examples.en: Should you have any questions about the fix, reach out.
examples.hi: यदि fix को लेकर कोई प्रश्न हो, तो संपर्क करें।

examples.en: Should you have any questions, a call also works.
examples.hi: यदि कोई प्रश्न हो, तो एक call भी ठीक रहेगी।

examples.en: Should you have any questions, see the appendix.
examples.hi: यदि कोई प्रश्न हो, तो appendix देखें।

common_mistake.wrong: For any queries kindly revert.
common_mistake.right: Should you have any questions, please get in touch.
common_mistake.why: Avoid 'kindly revert'; use a natural closing invitation.

cloze.sentence: ____, I'm happy to provide more details.

en_def: a simple polite phrase asking someone to tell you something
hi_def: किसी से कुछ बताने को कहने का एक सरल विनम्र वाक्यांश
hi_nuance: Very common and natural. Follow with 'if', 'whether', or a noun. Cleaner than 'kindly intimate me'.

examples.en: Please let me know if you need a video PoC.
examples.hi: अगर आपको video PoC चाहिए तो कृपया बताएँ।

examples.en: Please let me know whether this is in scope.
examples.hi: कृपया बताएँ कि यह in scope है या नहीं।

examples.en: Please let me know the expected timeline.
examples.hi: कृपया अपेक्षित timeline बताएँ।

examples.en: Please let me know once the fix is live.
examples.hi: Fix live होते ही कृपया बताएँ।

examples.en: Please let me know if I missed anything.
examples.hi: अगर मुझसे कुछ छूट गया हो तो कृपया बताएँ।

common_mistake.wrong: Kindly intimate me once done.
common_mistake.right: Please let me know once it's done.
common_mistake.why: 'intimate' as 'inform' is an Indianism; use 'let me know'.

cloze.sentence: ____ if you need the raw request or a screen recording.

en_def: an Indian-English phrase meaning 'as soon as possible'; sounds incomplete to native readers
hi_def: एक भारतीय-अंग्रेज़ी वाक्यांश जिसका अर्थ है 'जितनी जल्दी हो सके'; native पाठकों को अधूरा लगता है
hi_nuance: Indianism to unlearn. Use 'as soon as possible' or 'at your earliest convenience' instead.

examples.en: Awkward: Please fix this at the earliest.
examples.hi: अटपटा: Please fix this at the earliest।

examples.en: Natural: Please fix this as soon as possible.
examples.hi: स्वाभाविक: कृपया इसे जितनी जल्दी हो सके ठीक करें।

examples.en: Natural: Please fix this at your earliest convenience.
examples.hi: स्वाभाविक: कृपया अपनी सुविधानुसार जल्द इसे ठीक करें।

examples.en: We need the patch as soon as possible.
examples.hi: हमें patch जितनी जल्दी हो सके चाहिए।

examples.en: Could you deploy it soon, ideally today?
examples.hi: क्या आप इसे जल्द, आदर्श रूप से आज, deploy कर सकते हैं?

common_mistake.wrong: Kindly patch it at the earliest.
common_mistake.right: Please patch it as soon as possible.
common_mistake.why: 'at the earliest' is an Indianism; use 'as soon as possible'.

cloze.sentence: Replace 'at the earliest' with 'as soon as ____'.

word: I would like to bring to your notice
ipa: /aɪ wʊd laɪk tə brɪŋ tə jɔːr ˈnoʊtɪs/
en_def: an over-formal Indian-English phrase meaning 'I want to point out'; sounds heavy to native readers
hi_def: एक अति-औपचारिक भारतीय-अंग्रेज़ी वाक्यांश जिसका अर्थ है 'मैं बताना चाहता हूँ'; native पाठकों को भारी लगता है
hi_nuance: Indianism to lighten. Natural alternatives: 'I'd like to point out' or 'I want to flag'.

examples.en: Heavy: I would like to bring to your notice a bug.
examples.hi: भारी: I would like to bring to your notice एक bug।

examples.en: Natural: I'd like to flag a security bug.
examples.hi: स्वाभाविक: मैं एक security bug की ओर ध्यान दिलाना चाहता हूँ।

examples.en: Natural: I want to point out a serious issue.
examples.hi: स्वाभाविक: मैं एक गंभीर issue बताना चाहता हूँ।

examples.en: I'd like to flag that the token never expires.
examples.hi: मैं बताना चाहता हूँ कि token कभी expire नहीं होता।

examples.en: Just flagging a possible authorization gap.
examples.hi: बस एक संभावित authorization खामी की ओर ध्यान दिला रहा हूँ।

word_family: I would like to bring to your notice

common_mistake.wrong: I would like to bring to your kind notice the said issue.
common_mistake.right: I'd like to flag this issue.
common_mistake.why: Drop 'kind' and 'the said'; use a lighter, direct phrase.

cloze.sentence: Instead of the heavy opener, simply write: 'I'd like to ____ a security issue'.

en_def: a formal phrase meaning 'in addition to' or 'following on from' an earlier message
hi_def: एक औपचारिक वाक्यांश जिसका अर्थ है किसी पिछले संदेश के 'आगे' या 'उसके संदर्भ में'
hi_nuance: Formal email connector. Follow with a noun phrase: 'Further to my email...'. Natural: 'Following up on...'.

examples.en: Further to my report, I found a second issue.
examples.hi: मेरी report के आगे, मुझे एक दूसरा issue मिला।

examples.en: Further to our call, here are the logs.
examples.hi: हमारी call के आगे, यह रहीं logs।

examples.en: Further to your reply, I retested the fix.
examples.hi: आपके जवाब के आगे, मैंने fix retest किया।

examples.en: Further to the advisory, we added a patch.
examples.hi: Advisory के आगे, हमने एक patch जोड़ा।

examples.en: Following up on my last note, it's resolved.
examples.hi: मेरी पिछली बात के आगे, यह हल हो गया है।

common_mistake.wrong: Further to that, kindly do the needful on same.
common_mistake.right: Further to my last email, please deploy the fix.
common_mistake.why: Follow 'further to' with a noun phrase; avoid 'do the needful' and 'same'.

cloze.sentence: ____ my previous message, the vulnerability is still live.

en_def: to contact someone, often to ask for help or start a conversation
hi_def: किसी से संपर्क करना, अक्सर मदद माँगने या बातचीत शुरू करने के लिए
hi_nuance: Inseparable; 'reach out to someone'. Very common in professional English. Do not say 'reach out someone'.

examples.en: Feel free to reach out if you need more details.
examples.hi: और जानकारी चाहिए तो बेझिझक संपर्क करें।

examples.en: I reached out to the security team yesterday.
examples.hi: मैंने कल security team से संपर्क किया।

examples.en: Reach out to me on Slack for a quick call.
examples.hi: एक जल्दी call के लिए मुझसे Slack पर संपर्क करें।

examples.en: Please reach out to the vendor first.
examples.hi: कृपया पहले vendor से संपर्क करें।

examples.en: Thanks for reaching out about this issue.
examples.hi: इस issue के बारे में संपर्क करने के लिए धन्यवाद।

common_mistake.wrong: You can reach out me anytime.
common_mistake.right: You can reach out to me anytime.
common_mistake.why: 'reach out' needs 'to' before the person.

cloze.sentence: If anything is unclear, please ____ to me directly.

en_def: to include someone in a conversation or email so they stay informed
hi_def: किसी को बातचीt या email में शामिल करना ताकि वह जानकारी में रहे
hi_nuance: Separable: 'loop me in' / 'loop in the manager'. Workplace idiom, common on Slack and email threads.

examples.en: Let me loop in the backend team on this.
examples.hi: इस पर मैं backend team को loop in कर देता हूँ।

examples.en: Please loop me in when the fix is ready.
examples.hi: Fix तैयार हो तो कृपया मुझे loop in करें।

examples.en: I've looped in the security lead.
examples.hi: मैंने security lead को loop in कर दिया है।

examples.en: Should I loop in the product owner?
examples.hi: क्या मैं product owner को loop in करूँ?

examples.en: Loop me in if there are questions.
examples.hi: कोई सवाल हो तो मुझे loop in करें।

common_mistake.wrong: Please loop in me on this thread.
common_mistake.right: Please loop me in on this thread.
common_mistake.why: With a pronoun the phrasal verb splits: 'loop me in'.

cloze.sentence: Can you ____ the DevOps team ____ on the deployment plan? (fill the phrasal verb)

en_def: to return to a topic or person later
hi_def: किसी विषय या व्यक्ति पर बाद में लौटना
hi_nuance: Business idiom for 'come back to this later'. Inseparable; 'circle back on X' or 'circle back with you'.

examples.en: Let's circle back on the severity after the retest.
examples.hi: Retest के बाद severity पर फिर से लौटते हैं।

examples.en: I'll circle back with the logs this afternoon.
examples.hi: मैं दोपहर में logs के साथ फिर संपर्क करूँगा।

examples.en: Can we circle back to this next week?
examples.hi: क्या हम अगले हफ़्ते इस पर लौट सकते हैं?

examples.en: I'll circle back once QA confirms the fix.
examples.hi: QA fix confirm करे तो मैं फिर संपर्क करूँगा।

examples.en: Let's park this and circle back later.
examples.hi: इसे फ़िलहाल रोकते हैं और बाद में लौटते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: I will circle back you tomorrow.
common_mistake.right: I will circle back with you tomorrow.
common_mistake.why: Use 'circle back with you' or 'circle back to this'.

cloze.sentence: Let's ____ on the reward amount after triage is done.

en_def: to make brief contact with someone to share or check status
hi_def: स्थिति साझा करने या जाँचने के लिए किसी से संक्षिप्त संपर्क करना
hi_nuance: Idiom from baseball; means a quick check-in. 'touch base with someone', not 'touch base to someone'.

examples.en: Let's touch base tomorrow on the fix status.
examples.hi: Fix की स्थिति पर कल संक्षिप्त बात करते हैं।

examples.en: I wanted to touch base about the timeline.
examples.hi: मैं timeline को लेकर एक बार बात करना चाहता था।

examples.en: Can we touch base after your standup?
examples.hi: क्या हम आपके standup के बाद बात कर सकते हैं?

examples.en: I'll touch base with the vendor this week.
examples.hi: मैं इस हफ़्ते vendor से बात कर लूँगा।

examples.en: Quick touch base: is the patch live yet?
examples.hi: जल्दी से पूछ रहा हूँ: क्या patch live हो गया?

common_mistake.wrong: Let's touch base to you on Friday.
common_mistake.right: Let's touch base with you on Friday.
common_mistake.why: Use 'touch base with', not 'to'.

cloze.sentence: Let's ____ next week to confirm the retest results.

en_def: a phrase meaning 'on my side' or 'from where I am'
hi_def: एक वाक्यांश जिसका अर्थ है 'मेरी ओर से' या 'मेरी तरफ़'
hi_nuance: Natural in professional English. Prefer this to the Indianism 'from my end' in some contexts; both are common, 'on my end' is very idiomatic.

examples.en: The exploit still works on my end.
examples.hi: मेरी ओर से exploit अब भी काम करता है।

examples.en: Everything looks fine on my end after the patch.
examples.hi: Patch के बाद मेरी ओर से सब ठीक दिखता है।

examples.en: I can't reproduce it on my end.
examples.hi: मैं इसे अपनी ओर reproduce नहीं कर पा रहा।

examples.en: On my end, the request returns a 200.
examples.hi: मेरी ओर से request 200 लौटाती है।

examples.en: Nothing to add on my end.
examples.hi: मेरी ओर से जोड़ने को कुछ नहीं है।

common_mistake.wrong: The bug is not coming in my end.
common_mistake.right: The bug does not reproduce on my end.
common_mistake.why: Use 'on my end' and 'does not reproduce', not 'is not coming in'.

cloze.sentence: I retested and the issue is gone ____.

en_def: to point out something that needs attention
hi_def: किसी ऐसी चीज़ की ओर ध्यान दिलाना जिस पर ध्यान देने की ज़रूरत है
hi_nuance: Light, natural alternative to the heavy 'bring to your notice'. 'flag an issue', 'flag a risk'.

examples.en: I want to flag a possible authorization gap.
examples.hi: मैं एक संभावित authorization खामी की ओर ध्यान दिलाना चाहता हूँ।

examples.en: Just flagging that the token never expires.
examples.hi: बस यह बता रहा हूँ कि token कभी expire नहीं होता।

examples.en: The scanner flagged this endpoint as risky.
examples.hi: Scanner ने इस endpoint को जोखिम भरा बताया।

examples.en: Please flag any regressions you notice.
examples.hi: आपको कोई regression दिखे तो कृपया बताएँ।

examples.en: I flagged the issue to the on-call engineer.
examples.hi: मैंने issue on-call engineer को बताया।

common_mistake.wrong: I would like to bring to your notice one gap, flagging same.
common_mistake.right: I want to flag one authorization gap.
common_mistake.why: Use the light verb 'flag'; drop the heavy Indianism and 'same'.

cloze.sentence: I just want to ____ a small risk before the release.

en_def: to express worry about something in a professional way
hi_def: किसी बात को लेकर पेशेवर तरीक़े से चिंता व्यक्त करना
hi_nuance: 'raise' collocates with 'concern', 'issue', 'ticket', 'question'. Do not use 'rise' (intransitive) here.

examples.en: I'd like to raise a concern about the token design.
examples.hi: मैं token design को लेकर एक चिंता उठाना चाहता हूँ।

examples.en: Several users raised concerns about privacy.
examples.hi: कई users ने privacy को लेकर चिंताएँ उठाईं।

examples.en: Please raise a ticket for this bug.
examples.hi: कृपया इस bug के लिए एक ticket raise करें।

examples.en: I raised the concern in the review meeting.
examples.hi: मैंने review meeting में यह चिंता उठाई।

examples.en: If you disagree, raise it early.
examples.hi: अगर आप असहमत हैं, तो जल्दी बताएँ।

common_mistake.wrong: I want to rise a concern about this.
common_mistake.right: I want to raise a concern about this.
common_mistake.why: 'raise' (transitive) takes an object; 'rise' does not.

cloze.sentence: I'd like to ____ about the lack of rate limiting.

en_def: to reach agreement with others on something
hi_def: किसी बात पर दूसरों के साथ सहमति बनाना
hi_nuance: Business idiom. 'align on the severity', 'align on next steps'. Inseparable.

examples.en: Let's align on the severity before we publish.
examples.hi: प्रकाशित करने से पहले severity पर सहमत हो जाएँ।

examples.en: We aligned on a 30-day timeline.
examples.hi: हम 30-दिन की timeline पर सहमत हुए।

examples.en: Can we align on who owns the fix?
examples.hi: क्या हम तय कर सकते हैं कि fix का owner कौन है?

examples.en: The teams aligned on the remediation plan.
examples.hi: Teams remediation plan पर सहमत हुईं।

examples.en: Let's align on scope first.
examples.hi: पहले scope पर सहमत हो जाएँ।

common_mistake.wrong: Let's align on about the timeline.
common_mistake.right: Let's align on the timeline.
common_mistake.why: 'align on' is already complete; do not add 'about'.

cloze.sentence: Before the call ends, let's ____ the next steps.

en_def: to get others to agree to and support a plan
hi_def: किसी योजना के लिए दूसरों की सहमति और समर्थन प्राप्त करना
hi_nuance: 'buy-in' (noun) is hyphenated. Common when a fix needs manager or team approval.

examples.en: We need buy-in from management to prioritise this.
examples.hi: इसे प्राथमिकता देने के लिए हमें management की सहमति चाहिए।

examples.en: Getting buy-in early avoids delays.
examples.hi: जल्दी सहमति पाने से देरी टलती है।

examples.en: The plan has full buy-in from the team.
examples.hi: Team की इस योजना को पूरी सहमति है।

examples.en: Without buy-in, the fix will slip.
examples.hi: सहमति के बिना, fix टल जाएगा।

examples.en: I'm working to get buy-in for the redesign.
examples.hi: मैं redesign के लिए सहमति जुटाने में लगा हूँ।

common_mistake.wrong: We need to get buy in of the manager.
common_mistake.right: We need to get buy-in from the manager.
common_mistake.why: Hyphenate 'buy-in'; use 'from', not 'of'.

cloze.sentence: A big redesign needs ____ from the whole team.

en_def: clear and specific enough that someone can act on it
hi_def: इतना स्पष्ट और ठोस कि कोई उस पर कार्रवाई कर सके
hi_nuance: Good reports give 'actionable' remediation. Vague advice is not actionable.

examples.en: The report gives actionable remediation steps.
examples.hi: Report actionable remediation steps देती है।

examples.en: Make the feedback actionable, not vague.
examples.hi: Feedback को अस्पष्ट नहीं, actionable बनाएँ।

examples.en: Each finding has an actionable fix.
examples.hi: हर finding का एक actionable fix है।

examples.en: That advice is not actionable as written.
examples.hi: जैसा लिखा है, वह सलाह actionable नहीं है।

examples.en: We turned the audit into actionable tasks.
examples.hi: हमने audit को actionable tasks में बदला।

common_mistake.wrong: Please give actionable type steps.
common_mistake.right: Please give actionable steps.
common_mistake.why: Drop 'type'; 'actionable steps' is complete.

cloze.sentence: A good report includes clear, ____ remediation advice.

en_def: the main point or lesson to remember from something
hi_def: किसी चीज़ से याद रखने योग्य मुख्य बिंदु या सीख
hi_nuance: One word in this sense. 'the key takeaway is...'. Different from the food meaning.

examples.en: The key takeaway is to validate input on the server.
examples.hi: मुख्य takeaway यह है कि input server पर validate करें।

examples.en: My main takeaway from the audit is weak logging.
examples.hi: Audit से मेरा मुख्य takeaway कमज़ोर logging है।

examples.en: Here are three takeaways from the test.
examples.hi: Test से यहाँ तीन takeaways हैं।

examples.en: The takeaway: never trust client-side checks.
examples.hi: Takeaway: client-side checks पर कभी भरोसा न करें।

examples.en: That's the biggest takeaway for the team.
examples.hi: यह team के लिए सबसे बड़ा takeaway है।

common_mistake.wrong: The take away from this is clear.
common_mistake.right: The takeaway from this is clear.
common_mistake.why: As a noun it is one word 'takeaway'.

cloze.sentence: The main ____ is that all input must be validated server-side.

en_def: the gradual, uncontrolled growth of a project's or test's scope
hi_def: किसी project या test की scope का धीरे-धीरे, अनियंत्रित रूप से बढ़ना
hi_nuance: Uncountable. In pentesting, testing beyond the agreed scope is both scope creep and a policy risk.

examples.en: Scope creep made the engagement run over.
examples.hi: Scope creep ने engagement को समय से आगे खींचा।

examples.en: We froze the scope to avoid scope creep.
examples.hi: Scope creep से बचने के लिए हमने scope freeze किया।

examples.en: Extra requests caused scope creep.
examples.hi: अतिरिक्त माँगों ने scope creep पैदा किया।

examples.en: Watch for scope creep in long tests.
examples.hi: लंबे tests में scope creep का ध्यान रखें।

examples.en: Scope creep blurs what is in scope.
examples.hi: Scope creep यह धुँधला कर देता है कि क्या in scope है।

common_mistake.wrong: Many scope creeps happened in this project.
common_mistake.right: There was a lot of scope creep in this project.
common_mistake.why: 'scope creep' is uncountable; do not pluralise it.

cloze.sentence: Adding new targets mid-test causes ____.

en_def: something that stops work from continuing until it is resolved
hi_def: कोई चीज़ जो हल होने तक काम को आगे बढ़ने से रोक देती है
hi_nuance: Common in agile/standups. 'a blocker', 'blocked on'. State blockers clearly to get help fast.

examples.en: The missing test account is a blocker.
examples.hi: Test account न होना एक blocker है।

examples.en: I'm blocked on access to the staging server.
examples.hi: मैं staging server की access पर blocked हूँ।

examples.en: Any blockers before the retest?
examples.hi: Retest से पहले कोई blockers?

examples.en: This dependency is our main blocker.
examples.hi: यह dependency हमारा मुख्य blocker है।

examples.en: Let me know if you hit a blocker.
examples.hi: कोई blocker आए तो बताइए।

common_mistake.wrong: I am block on the credentials.
common_mistake.right: I am blocked on the credentials.
common_mistake.why: Use the past participle 'blocked'.

cloze.sentence: Without test credentials, verifying the fix is a ____.

en_def: the time or capacity someone has to take on work
hi_def: किसी के पास काम लेने का समय या क्षमता
hi_nuance: Figurative office use, uncountable. 'I don't have the bandwidth this week'. Different from network bandwidth.

examples.en: I don't have the bandwidth to retest today.
examples.hi: आज retest करने की मेरे पास bandwidth नहीं है।

examples.en: Do you have bandwidth to review this?
examples.hi: क्या आपके पास इसे review करने की bandwidth है?

examples.en: The team has limited bandwidth this sprint.
examples.hi: इस sprint में team के पास सीमित bandwidth है।

examples.en: I'll have more bandwidth next week.
examples.hi: अगले हफ़्ते मेरे पास ज़्यादा bandwidth होगी।

examples.en: We lack the bandwidth for a full audit now.
examples.hi: अभी पूरे audit के लिए हमारे पास bandwidth नहीं है।

common_mistake.wrong: I have no bandwidths this week.
common_mistake.right: I have no bandwidth this week.
common_mistake.why: In this sense 'bandwidth' is uncountable; no plural.

cloze.sentence: Sorry, I don't have the ____ to review the report until Monday.

en_def: to give final approval to something
hi_def: किसी चीज़ को अंतिम स्वीकृति देना
hi_nuance: Verb 'sign off (on)'; noun 'sign-off' is hyphenated. 'sign off on the fix' = approve it.

examples.en: The lead needs to sign off on the release.
examples.hi: Lead को release पर sign off करना होगा।

examples.en: We can't ship without security sign-off.
examples.hi: Security sign-off के बिना हम ship नहीं कर सकते।

examples.en: Please sign off once the retest passes.
examples.hi: Retest पास होते ही कृपया sign off करें।

examples.en: QA signed off on the patch.
examples.hi: QA ने patch पर sign off किया।

examples.en: I'll sign off after the final check.
examples.hi: अंतिम जाँच के बाद मैं sign off कर दूँगा।

common_mistake.wrong: Please do the signoff of the release.
common_mistake.right: Please sign off on the release.
common_mistake.why: Use the verb 'sign off on'; 'do the signoff of' is awkward.

cloze.sentence: The security team must ____ on the change before it ships.

en_def: the time taken to complete a task or respond to a request
hi_def: किसी काम को पूरा करने या किसी अनुरोध का जवाब देने में लगने वाला समय
hi_nuance: Often abbreviated TAT in Indian offices; write it out in external communication. 'a quick turnaround time'.

examples.en: Their triage turnaround time is under a day.
examples.hi: उनका triage turnaround time एक दिन से कम है।

examples.en: What's the expected turnaround time for a fix?
examples.hi: Fix के लिए अपेक्षित turnaround time क्या है?

examples.en: A fast turnaround time keeps researchers happy.
examples.hi: तेज़ turnaround time researchers को ख़ुश रखता है।

examples.en: The turnaround time for retests is two days.
examples.hi: Retests का turnaround time दो दिन है।

examples.en: We aim for a 24-hour turnaround time.
examples.hi: हम 24-घंटे के turnaround time का लक्ष्य रखते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: What is the TAT for the fix?
common_mistake.right: What is the turnaround time for the fix?
common_mistake.why: Avoid the abbreviation 'TAT' with external readers; write it in full.

cloze.sentence: Their average ____ for triaging a report is one day.

en_def: by the end of the working day; often abbreviated EOD
hi_def: कामकाजी दिन के अंत तक; अक्सर EOD के रूप में संक्षिप्त
hi_nuance: Common deadline phrase. Specify a timezone for global teams, since 'EOD' is ambiguous across regions.

examples.en: I'll send the report by end of day.
examples.hi: मैं report end of day तक भेज दूँगा।

examples.en: Can you deploy the fix by EOD?
examples.hi: क्या आप fix EOD तक deploy कर सकते हैं?

examples.en: The logs will be ready end of day IST.
examples.hi: Logs end of day IST तक तैयार होंगी।

examples.en: Let's aim for end of day tomorrow.
examples.hi: कल end of day का लक्ष्य रखते हैं।

examples.en: I need sign-off by end of day.
examples.hi: मुझे end of day तक sign-off चाहिए।

common_mistake.wrong: I will revert by end of day.
common_mistake.right: I will reply by end of day.
common_mistake.why: 'revert' meaning 'reply' is an Indianism; keep the timing phrase, fix the verb.

cloze.sentence: Please confirm the severity by ____ so we can plan the fix.

en_def: a vulnerability that is exploited before a fix is available
hi_def: एक vulnerability जिसका फ़ायदा fix उपलब्ध होने से पहले उठाया जाता है
hi_nuance: Hyphenated. Countable: 'a zero-day', 'zero-days'. Often shortened to '0-day'. Higher urgency by definition.

examples.en: Attackers used a zero-day against the mail server.
examples.hi: हमलावरों ने mail server के ख़िलाफ़ एक zero-day इस्तेमाल किया।

examples.en: A zero-day has no patch yet.
examples.hi: एक zero-day का अभी कोई patch नहीं होता।

examples.en: The vendor rushed a fix after the zero-day.
examples.hi: Zero-day के बाद vendor ने जल्दी में fix निकाला।

examples.en: Zero-days are traded on underground markets.
examples.hi: Zero-days underground markets में बेचे जाते हैं।

examples.en: This is not a zero-day; a patch already exists.
examples.hi: यह zero-day नहीं है; patch पहले से मौजूद है।

common_mistake.wrong: It is a zero day which has a patch since long.
common_mistake.right: It is not a zero-day, because a patch has existed for a long time.
common_mistake.why: A zero-day has no patch; if a patch exists, it is no longer a zero-day.

cloze.sentence: Because no fix exists yet, this is a true ____.

en_def: a hidden way to bypass normal authentication and gain access
hi_def: सामान्य authentication को दरकिनार कर access पाने का एक छिपा हुआ रास्ता
hi_nuance: One word. Can be malicious (planted by attacker) or an insecure 'debug backdoor' left by developers.

examples.en: The malware installs a backdoor for later access.
examples.hi: Malware बाद की access के लिए एक backdoor लगाता है।

examples.en: A hidden admin account acts as a backdoor.
examples.hi: एक छिपा हुआ admin account backdoor की तरह काम करता है।

examples.en: We removed the developer's debug backdoor.
examples.hi: हमने developer का debug backdoor हटाया।

examples.en: Backdoors are hard to detect without code review.
examples.hi: Code review के बिना backdoors पकड़ना कठिन है।

examples.en: The hardcoded password was effectively a backdoor.
examples.hi: Hardcoded password असल में एक backdoor था।

common_mistake.wrong: There is a back door in the code left by developer.
common_mistake.right: There is a backdoor in the code left by a developer.
common_mistake.why: One word 'backdoor'; add the article 'a developer'.

cloze.sentence: The hardcoded admin login is essentially a ____ into the system.

en_def: an urgent, small fix released quickly to solve a serious problem
hi_def: किसी गंभीर समस्या को हल करने के लिए जल्दी जारी किया गया एक छोटा, तत्काल fix
hi_nuance: One word. Smaller and faster than a full release. Often followed by a proper patch later.

examples.en: They shipped a hotfix within hours.
examples.hi: उन्होंने कुछ घंटों में एक hotfix जारी किया।

examples.en: The hotfix disables the vulnerable endpoint.
examples.hi: यह hotfix vulnerable endpoint को disable करता है।

examples.en: A hotfix is temporary; a proper patch follows.
examples.hi: Hotfix अस्थायी होता है; एक proper patch बाद में आता है।

examples.en: We applied the hotfix to production first.
examples.hi: हमने hotfix पहले production पर लगाया।

examples.en: The hotfix broke another feature.
examples.hi: Hotfix ने एक और feature तोड़ दिया।

common_mistake.wrong: We released a hot fix for the same.
common_mistake.right: We released a hotfix for this issue.
common_mistake.why: One word 'hotfix'; 'for the same' is an Indianism for 'for this'.

cloze.sentence: To stop active exploitation, the team pushed an emergency ____.

en_def: returning a system to a previous working version
hi_def: किसी सिस्टम को पिछले काम करने वाले version पर लौटाना
hi_nuance: Noun 'rollback' (one word); verb 'roll back' (two words). Useful when a fix causes a regression.

examples.en: The bad deploy forced a rollback.
examples.hi: ख़राब deploy ने एक rollback कराया।

examples.en: We rolled back to the previous version.
examples.hi: हम पिछले version पर roll back हुए।

examples.en: Have a rollback plan before deploying.
examples.hi: Deploy करने से पहले एक rollback plan रखें।

examples.en: The rollback restored service in minutes.
examples.hi: Rollback ने कुछ मिनटों में service बहाल की।

examples.en: Roll back the change if the retest fails.
examples.hi: अगर retest विफल हो तो change roll back करें।

common_mistake.wrong: We did rollback of the deployment.
common_mistake.right: We rolled back the deployment.
common_mistake.why: Use the verb 'rolled back'; 'did rollback of' is awkward.

cloze.sentence: If the patch breaks login, we will ____ to the last stable build.

en_def: a case where a real problem is missed and reported as safe
hi_def: ऐसा मामला जहाँ असली समस्या छूट जाती है और उसे सुरक्षित बता दिया जाता है
hi_nuance: Opposite of 'false positive'. In security, false negatives are more dangerous because real risks are hidden.

examples.en: The scanner missed it, a classic false negative.
examples.hi: Scanner ने इसे चूक दिया, एक classic false negative।

examples.en: False negatives give a false sense of safety.
examples.hi: False negatives झूठी सुरक्षा का एहसास देते हैं।

examples.en: Manual testing found the false negative.
examples.hi: Manual testing ने false negative खोजा।

examples.en: A false negative is worse than a false positive.
examples.hi: एक false negative, false positive से बुरा है।

examples.en: Tuning reduced false negatives.
examples.hi: Tuning ने false negatives घटाए।
