common_mistake.wrong: The scanner gave false negative for this bug.
common_mistake.right: The scanner produced a false negative for this bug.
common_mistake.why: Add the article 'a' and use 'produced'.

cloze.sentence: Because the tool marked a real flaw as safe, it was a ____.

en_def: the risk that remains after controls have been applied
hi_def: controls लागू करने के बाद बचा हुआ जोखिम
hi_nuance: Compliance and reporting term. No control removes all risk; the leftover is the residual risk to accept or treat.

examples.en: After the fix, the residual risk is low.
examples.hi: Fix के बाद, residual risk कम है।

examples.en: Management chose to accept the residual risk.
examples.hi: Management ने residual risk स्वीकार किया।

examples.en: Document the residual risk in the report.
examples.hi: Report में residual risk document करें।

examples.en: The workaround lowers but leaves residual risk.
examples.hi: Workaround जोखिम घटाता है पर residual risk छोड़ता है।

examples.en: Residual risk should be reviewed regularly.
examples.hi: Residual risk की नियमित समीक्षा होनी चाहिए।

common_mistake.wrong: After fixing, there is no any residual risk.
common_mistake.right: After fixing, the residual risk is minimal.
common_mistake.why: 'no any' is wrong; and some residual risk almost always remains.

cloze.sentence: Even after mitigation, some ____ remains and must be accepted.

en_def: a structured view of who might attack a system, how, and what to protect
hi_def: इसका एक संरचित विवरण कि किसी सिस्टम पर कौन, कैसे हमला कर सकता है और क्या बचाना है
hi_nuance: Both noun and verb ('threat-model the feature'). Built early in design to guide security decisions.

examples.en: We built a threat model for the payment flow.
examples.hi: हमने payment flow के लिए एक threat model बनाया।

examples.en: The threat model lists the main attackers.
examples.hi: Threat model मुख्य हमलावरों को सूचीबद्ध करता है।

examples.en: Threat-model the design before you build it.
examples.hi: Build करने से पहले design को threat-model करें।

examples.en: The threat model missed insider risk.
examples.hi: Threat model insider जोखिम को चूक गया।

examples.en: Update the threat model when the design changes.
examples.hi: Design बदलने पर threat model update करें।

common_mistake.wrong: We did threat modelling of the app in last.
common_mistake.right: We threat-modeled the app early in the design.
common_mistake.why: Prefer the verb; 'in last' is an Indianism for 'at the end' but here 'early' fits.

cloze.sentence: Before coding, the team creates a ____ to plan defenses.

en_def: written directly into the source code instead of being configurable
hi_def: configurable होने के बजाय सीधे source code में लिखा हुआ
hi_nuance: One word. 'hardcoded credentials' is a frequent finding. Secrets should be in a vault, not hardcoded.

examples.en: The API key is hardcoded in the app.
examples.hi: API key app में hardcoded है।

examples.en: Hardcoded passwords are a serious risk.
examples.hi: Hardcoded passwords एक गंभीर जोखिम हैं।

examples.en: Move the hardcoded secret to a vault.
examples.hi: Hardcoded secret को एक vault में ले जाएँ।

examples.en: The URL is hardcoded, not configurable.
examples.hi: URL hardcoded है, configurable नहीं।

examples.en: We found a hardcoded admin token.
examples.hi: हमें एक hardcoded admin token मिला।

common_mistake.wrong: The password is hard coded in the source.
common_mistake.right: The password is hardcoded in the source.
common_mistake.why: One word 'hardcoded' as an adjective.

cloze.sentence: The secret should be in a vault, not ____ in the repository.

en_def: to mark something as outdated and discourage its use, often before removing it
hi_def: किसी चीज़ को पुराना बताकर उसके उपयोग को हतोत्साहित करना, अक्सर हटाने से पहले
hi_nuance: 'deprecated' features still work but should not be used. Insecure algorithms (e.g. MD5) are often deprecated.

examples.en: We deprecated the old, insecure endpoint.
examples.hi: हमने पुराने, असुरक्षित endpoint को deprecate किया।

examples.en: MD5 is deprecated for password hashing.
examples.hi: Password hashing के लिए MD5 deprecated है।

examples.en: The deprecated API will be removed next year.
examples.hi: Deprecated API अगले साल हटा दिया जाएगा।

examples.en: Please migrate off the deprecated library.
examples.hi: कृपया deprecated library से migrate करें।

examples.en: They deprecated TLS 1.0 for security reasons.
examples.hi: सुरक्षा कारणों से उन्होंने TLS 1.0 deprecate किया।

common_mistake.wrong: This function is depreciated, do not use.
common_mistake.right: This function is deprecated; do not use it.
common_mistake.why: 'depreciate' means lose value; 'deprecate' means mark as outdated.

cloze.sentence: The weak cipher was ____ and replaced with a modern one.

en_def: a quick, basic check to confirm something is roughly correct
hi_def: यह पुष्टि करने के लिए एक जल्दी, बुनियादी जाँच कि कोई चीज़ मोटे तौर पर सही है
hi_nuance: Common in engineering. 'do a sanity check', 'a quick sanity check'. Not a full test, just a basic one.

examples.en: Let me do a quick sanity check on the payload.
examples.hi: मैं payload की एक जल्दी sanity check कर लेता हूँ।

examples.en: As a sanity check, I re-ran the exploit.
examples.hi: Sanity check के तौर पर, मैंने exploit दोबारा चलाया।

examples.en: A sanity check confirmed the fix works.
examples.hi: एक sanity check ने पुष्टि की कि fix काम करता है।

examples.en: Just a sanity check: is this the right host?
examples.hi: बस एक sanity check: क्या यह सही host है?

examples.en: The sanity check caught a wrong config.
examples.hi: Sanity check ने एक ग़लत config पकड़ी।

common_mistake.wrong: Let me do one sanity checking of the numbers.
common_mistake.right: Let me do a quick sanity check of the numbers.
common_mistake.why: Use the noun 'sanity check', not 'sanity checking'.

cloze.sentence: Before I report it, let me do a quick ____ that it still reproduces.

en_def: data stored on a disk or database, not currently moving over a network
hi_def: disk या database पर संग्रहीत data, जो अभी network पर नहीं चल रहा
hi_nuance: Paired with 'data in transit'. 'encryption at rest' protects stored data if a disk is stolen.

examples.en: Encrypt sensitive data at rest.
examples.hi: संवेदनशील data at rest को encrypt करें।

examples.en: Data at rest was stored in plain text.
examples.hi: Data at rest plain text में संग्रहीत था।

examples.en: The database lacks encryption at rest.
examples.hi: Database में encryption at rest नहीं है।

examples.en: Data at rest and in transit need protection.
examples.hi: Data at rest और in transit दोनों को सुरक्षा चाहिए।

examples.en: Backups count as data at rest too.
examples.hi: Backups भी data at rest में गिने जाते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: The datas at rest are not encrypted.
common_mistake.right: The data at rest is not encrypted.
common_mistake.why: 'data' is uncountable; 'data ... is', no 'datas'.

cloze.sentence: The database stores card numbers as ____ without encryption.

en_def: data moving over a network between systems
hi_def: systems के बीच network पर चलता हुआ data
hi_nuance: Paired with 'data at rest'. Protected with TLS. Sending secrets over plain HTTP exposes data in transit.

examples.en: Use TLS to protect data in transit.
examples.hi: Data in transit की रक्षा के लिए TLS इस्तेमाल करें।

examples.en: The login sends data in transit over plain HTTP.
examples.hi: Login, data in transit को plain HTTP पर भेजता है।

examples.en: Data in transit can be intercepted without TLS.
examples.hi: TLS के बिना data in transit को intercept किया जा सकता है।

examples.en: Encrypt data in transit end to end.
examples.hi: Data in transit को end to end encrypt करें।

examples.en: The API protects data in transit but not at rest.
examples.hi: API, data in transit को बचाता है पर at rest को नहीं।

common_mistake.wrong: The data in transit is not encrypt.
common_mistake.right: The data in transit is not encrypted.
common_mistake.why: Use the past participle 'encrypted' after 'is not'.

cloze.sentence: Because the site uses plain HTTP, ____ can be sniffed.

en_def: to finish or conclude something
hi_def: किसी चीज़ को समाप्त करना या निष्कर्ष पर लाना
hi_nuance: Separable: 'wrap it up', 'wrap up the report'. Noun 'wrap-up' is hyphenated. Friendly way to close a task.

examples.en: Let's wrap up the engagement this week.
examples.hi: इस हफ़्ते engagement wrap up कर लेते हैं।

examples.en: I'll wrap up the report tonight.
examples.hi: मैं आज रात report wrap up कर दूँगा।

examples.en: Before we wrap up, any final questions?
examples.hi: समाप्त करने से पहले, कोई अंतिम सवाल?

examples.en: The retest wraps up the whole process.
examples.hi: Retest पूरी प्रक्रिया को समाप्त करता है।

examples.en: Here's a quick wrap-up of the findings.
examples.hi: यहाँ findings का एक जल्दी wrap-up है।

common_mistake.wrong: Let us wrap up this and I will send report.
common_mistake.right: Let's wrap this up, and I'll send the report.
common_mistake.why: Split the phrasal verb: 'wrap this up'; add the article 'the report'.

cloze.sentence: Before we ____, let me confirm all findings are documented.
